20797.name: is_f2

2850.name: on_foreground

307.name: description

4158.name: UiActivity

11860.name: press

15711.name: audio_no_speech

8663.name: quiet

Draws the dashes only while files are over the window, for a zone that is a whole
screen and should not look like one until then.

24067.name: ToolRail

24721.name: new

13895.name: disabled

22251.name: Tick
22251.docs: A marked stretch of the axis, in pixels from its start.

4304.name: disabled
4304.docs: Marks the control as not responding to input.

15857.name: diagnostics_unoptimized_detail
15857.docs: What a build without optimizations means, and what to do about it.

13968.name: angle_text
13968.docs: An angle as people read it: `+3.5°`, `-0.1°`, `0.0°`, never `-0.0°`.

10771.name: rows
10771.docs: The current rows (tracked: views reading it rebuild on change).

7574.name: time_from_digits
7574.docs: Reads the four digits a time field holds, once they are all there.

22324.name: TALL_LANE_HEIGHT
22324.docs: A lane whose bars have a second line.

26175.name: scrolled_at
26175.docs: When each scroll container last moved: its scrollbar shows only around that.

15930.name: histogram_clipped_high
15930.docs: What a [`Histogram`](crate::Histogram) says when a channel piles up at its high end.

26248.name: scale
26248.docs: The device scale factor (physical pixels per logical pixel).

16003.name: grid_scenario_update
16003.docs: Saves over the scenario in use.

9609.name: show_for
9609.docs: Shows a toast for `seconds` seconds. At most four are kept; the oldest go first.

13460.name: icon
13460.docs: Its icon, instead of a crosshair.

21162.name: badge
21162.docs: Marks the version, such as "Installed" or "New".

19273.name: open
19273.docs: Whether a collapsible group starts unfolded (true by default).

12225.name: keyed_selection
12225.docs: Selection by the row indices the grid works with, kept as the keys of those rows.

16076.name: playground_hide_output
16076.docs: Folds the output of a [`Playground`](crate::Playground) away.

9682.name: TOAST_OVERLAY_KEY
9682.docs: The layers of a [`Toaster`], one for each corner in use.

20581.name: download
20581.docs:
A button that saves what `make` turns the code into, such as a project to build, with
the system's dialog on a desktop or as a download in a browser. `make` gives the file's
name and bytes, or the problems to mark in the code.

2634.name: FavoriteToggle

14841.name: viewport
14841.docs: The size of the view on screen, written by [`ZoomPanView`] and read by [`Minimap`].

23197.name: SHEET_GROUP_WIDTH
23197.docs: Width of a group of a sheet, so that as many as fit stand side by side.

2053.name: busy
2053.docs:
Whether an answer is on its way: nothing is sent until it arrives, and what is
being written stays in the field.

20654.name: height
20654.docs: The height of the field (600 by default); it fills the width it is given.

18765.name: Sidebar

4669.name: is_hover_within
4669.docs: The pointer is over this view or over any interactive element inside it.

1472.name: curve
1472.docs: How lines go from point to point (natural by default).

9828.name: width
9828.docs: Sets the width in logical pixels (240 by default).

2780.name: label
2780.docs: What it is for, for screen readers, instead of the words in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

3434.name: label
3434.docs: How it is written next to a command, such as `⌘S` or `Ctrl+S`.

14333.name: wrap
14333.docs: Whether going past the last picture comes back to the first (it does not by default).

16295.name: color
16295.docs: A color for telling it apart.

13098.name: picture_inks
13098.docs:
Two inks that read over any picture together, the light one and the dark one. They come from
the theme but do not swap with it: a picture stays the same in a light theme.

16949.name: selection
16949.docs: How the pointer and the keyboard change a selection of many, wherever it is shown.

17603.name: query
17603.docs: What was typed in the search box; empty at first.

310.name: selected
310.docs: Lights the button up as being on, and announces it as a button that toggles.

8012.name: SPLIT_BAR
8012.docs: How wide the bar between panes is, grip and room around it, in logical pixels.

964.name: Appear
964.docs: How far a chart's data has drawn in, from 0 to 1, and how it does.

11863.name: Zones
11863.docs: Where things landed in the last paint, to tell what a drag is over.

15714.name: chat_open
15714.docs: Opens a file in a [`Chat`](crate::Chat), with `{what}` for what it is.

8666.name: fill
8666.docs: Takes the free space of the parent, for a zone that is a whole screen.

24724.name: most
24724.docs: The most values that can be chosen.

21527.name: Command
21527.docs: An item, wrapped in a tooltip when it has one (icon-only items always do).

11282.name: rows
11282.docs: The rows, at most as many as were asked for.

15787.name: tile_move
15787.docs: The handle that moves a tile of a [`TileLayout`](crate::TileLayout).

16441.name: lists
16441.docs:
Long lists and the navigation built on them: [`VirtualList`] underneath, and
[`Filmstrip`], [`PagedDocumentView`] and [`FileBrowser`] on top of it. [`SortableList`] and
[`DocumentTabs`] share the arithmetic of a reorder drag.

6850.name: split_group
6850.docs: Opens a group of `id` on the edge of the group of `beside`.

14552.name: clip_share
14552.docs:
The share of a channel that must sit in an end bin to light that end's mark, from 0
to 1 (0.001 by default, which ignores a stray reflection).

11355.name: end
11355.docs: One past the last row known to exist.

4307.name: active
4307.docs:
Marks the option highlighted in a list that a focused text field
drives (combobox pattern), so screen readers announce it.

15860.name: diagnostics_frame
15860.docs: Diagnostics: the time of a whole frame.

9466.name: shown_at
9466.docs: When it was first shown, on the UI clock.

2418.name: count
2418.docs: Shows how many things this button stands for after the label, as in a filter.

10774.name: set_cell
10774.docs: Replaces one cell; out-of-range indices are ignored.

4380.name: clip
4380.docs: Children are clipped to the frame.

15933.name: color_saturation
15933.docs: The distance from gray on a [`ColorWheel`](crate::ColorWheel).

14698.name: WHEEL_MARGIN
14698.docs: Room around the disc, in logical pixels, for the puck at the edge.

22400.name: done
22400.docs: It already happened, so it stands back.

9612.name: show_with
9612.docs:
Shows a toast for `seconds` seconds, with a button or something to run once it is
gone. With `f64::INFINITY` it stays until closed.

13463.name: label
13463.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

3218.name: Hsv
3218.docs:
A color as people think of it. A gray keeps its hue, so moving through one
does not throw the choice back to red.

3872.name: raw
3872.docs: The raw identity, for derived ids such as accessibility node ids.

11574.name: row_action
11574.docs: Adds a button at the end of every row.

19276.name: action
19276.docs:
Adds a control at the end of the caption, usually a small [`IconButton`]
with a label, or a [`DropdownMenu`](crate::DropdownMenu). Hidden when
reduced to icons.

2637.name: new
2637.docs: A heart bound to `value`; clicking flips it.

13536.name: rect
13536.docs: The box before turning, in the units of the content.

23200.name: SHEET_LINE
23200.docs: The height of a line of a sheet and of a group's title, to tell when it may not fit.

2056.name: on_send
2056.docs: Called with what the person sent, after it joined the messages.

821.name: PICTURES_KEPT_BYTES
821.docs:
Bytes of pictures kept after their chart is gone: about ten charts filling a laptop's
screen at 2x.

4672.name: is_focus_visible
4672.docs: Focus is on this view and came from the keyboard.

8523.name: save
8523.docs: Hands a file over to the person.

1475.name: fill_opacity
1475.docs: How solid an area or a radar polygon is, from 0 to 1.

5980.name: id
5980.docs: What identifies it, in the arrangement and in what is saved. It should never change.

9831.name: read_only
9831.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

7288.name: NumberField

23346.name: click
23346.docs: The press and release of a mouse button.

16298.name: closable
16298.docs: Whether it has a button that closes it.

15717.name: folder_empty
15717.docs: What a [`FileBrowser`](crate::FileBrowser) shows in a folder with nothing in it.

12520.name: set_whole_filter
12520.docs:
Writes what the filter editor made in place of every expression the columns had,
in the column of the first one so it stays where it was.

24073.name: variant
24073.docs:
Adds a tool that shares this place. The others open in a menu at its side, by
holding the button down, by a right click or with the Right arrow, and the
place shows the last one used.

20876.name: Monthly
20876.docs: Every `interval` months, on the first day's date.

24727.name: label
24727.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

11285.name: totals
11285.docs: Aggregates per column, for the footer.

22184.name: TimeAxis
22184.docs: The stretch of time a [`Scheduler`](crate::Scheduler) shows, how wide it is and how it is marked.

11939.name: fixed
11939.docs: Pinned columns and where each sits from the left of the grid.

16444.name: file_browser
16444.docs: Folders and files, from whatever data the app has.

2348.name: paint_orb
2348.docs:
Paints the sphere: a calm disc over the page, leaving the accent to the icon and
to the screen's one main action. All of it is circles, so it needs nothing from the
renderer and looks the same in the browser.

6199.name: focus
6199.docs: The panel whose tab takes focus when it is next built.

13901.name: stage
13901.docs:
The view it goes over, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image) or a
[`ZoomPanView`](crate::ZoomPanView), which gives it its size. Without one, put it in
a [`ZStack`](crate::ZStack) with a fixed [size](Self::size).

21603.name: BodyPopup
21603.docs: The page body shown as a popup while the ribbon is collapsed.

14555.name: height
14555.docs: Height in logical pixels (96 by default).

15863.name: diagnostics_render
15863.docs: Diagnostics: the time spent recording and submitting GPU work.

9469.name: Toaster

20368.name: new
20368.docs: A strip of `content` moving left at 40 pixels a second.

10777.name: remove
10777.docs: Removes a row and returns it; an out-of-range index does nothing.

7580.name: DateTimePicker
7580.docs:
A [`DatePicker`] beside a [`TimePicker`], over one value. Picking a date first
sets the time to midnight, and clearing the time clears both.

22330.name: ROW_HOVER_TINT
22330.docs: How much of the row under the pointer is tinted.

4383.name: scrollbar_outside
4383.docs: How far past its edge the scrollbar goes.

26181.name: wake
26181.docs: Earliest time a widget asked to be rebuilt at.

15936.name: curve_points
15936.docs: After the number of points of a [`CurveEditor`](crate::CurveEditor).

3802.name: ask_typing
3802.docs:
Like [`ask`](Self::ask), for what is too costly to answer with one click: the
button called `action` only works after `word` is typed exactly as it is, capitals
included, so a hurried click never runs `run`.

22403.name: SchedulerEvent
22403.docs: A bar on a [`Scheduler`]. One with no length shows as a milestone.

23057.name: between
23057.docs:
Plays the whole effect inside this part of the range, `0.0..=1.0`: before `from`
it shows its start, after `to` its end. Scenes use it to give each step its turn.

16009.name: grid_try_again
16009.docs: Asks a server for a grid's rows again.

23711.name: min
23711.docs: The smallest size the spacer keeps along the stack's axis.

14120.name: stage
14120.docs:
The view it goes over, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image) or a
[`ZoomPanView`](crate::ZoomPanView), which gives it its size. Without one, put it in
a [`ZStack`](crate::ZStack) with a fixed [size](Self::size).

25019.name: theme
25019.docs: Adds a theme of the application's own to the menu, under its name.

11577.name: filter_builder
11577.docs:
Shows a Filter button in the toolbar that opens a [`FilterBuilder`](crate::FilterBuilder)
over the columns. What it writes is an expression, kept with the filters of
the filter row, so it goes in saved scenarios and comes out with Clear.

2640.name: size
2640.docs: Sets the size of the mark in logical pixels (16 by default). The target around it follows.

13539.name: TransformHandles

14847.name: centered_on
14847.docs: The same view around this point of the content, from 0 to 1 on each axis.

7799.name: FUNCTION_GROUPS
7799.docs:
The function groups, in the order of [`Labels::expression_groups`](crate::Labels::expression_groups)
after fields and parameters.

23203.name: ShortcutGroup
23203.docs: One group of a sheet, with what it holds as (keys, what they do).

20006.name: icon_only
20006.docs:
Shows only the icon, for a tight bar; the label still names the button for screen
readers. Give it an [`Self::icon`].

11069.name: keys_of
11069.docs: Sort keys of `column` for the rows in `indices`, in the same order.

170.name: IconName
170.docs: Icons available to [`Icon`](crate::Icon), from the Lucide set.

4675.name: children
4675.docs: Builds every view of a sequence as children.

1478.name: labels_at_zero
1478.docs:
The categories of bars sit on the line of zero, on its other side from the bar,
instead of along the edge of the chart: for values both ways from zero.

5983.name: closable
5983.docs: It has a way to close (on by default).

13685.name: EDGE_REACH
13685.docs: How far from a side a press takes that side.

6637.name: least
6637.docs: The least a node can be along `axis`.

7291.name: on_leave
7291.docs: Called when the keyboard goes elsewhere after being here.

23349.name: rate
23349.docs: How many samples make a second.

20152.name: pointer_in
20152.docs: A submenu tells the list that opened it when the pointer gets here.

13104.name: OverlayBox
13104.docs:
The box of a widget drawn over something: the size it was given, or that of the view it is
laid over.

15720.name: next_year
15720.docs: A [`YearView`](crate::YearView)'s button to the year after.

23422.docs:
Goes up each time something takes the place of what was being said, since a provider
does not report it, and whoever started it needs to know.

2278.name: PANEL_MARGIN
2278.docs: How far from the window's edges a layer stays, as every overlay does.

17028.name: LINE_STEP
17028.docs: What an arrow moves a list with nothing to select.

26038.docs:
How much a longer gap counts for: little enough not to skip the animation,
enough that a machine this slow still gets through it.

4894.name: on_exit
4894.docs: Adds a button to leave the selection, and makes Escape do the same.

15793.name: tag_add
15793.docs: What a [`TagBox`](crate::TagBox) option says when it adds `typed`.

17101.name: view
17101.docs: How long the view is, along the list.

17755.name: new
17755.docs: A lookup over options already in memory.

25457.name: new
25457.docs: A block known to the app as `id`, from `start_ms` for `duration_ms`.

15866.name: diagnostics_report_shares_detail
15866.docs: Diagnostics: what a bug report would share and that nothing is sent yet.

7583.name: new
7583.docs: `month` is shown when no date is selected yet.

16593.name: on_open
16593.docs: Called with an entry on a double click or on Enter.

22406.name: new
22406.docs: A bar on this row, from `start` to `end`.

26257.docs:
Sets the clock (seconds since the app started). Platforms call it before
handling events and before each frame. Animations start only once a
platform drives this clock.

Animations follow their own clock, which skips stalls: after a long pause
(a hidden window, a slow frame) they continue about where they were
instead of jumping to the end.

12161.name: fit_width
12161.docs: The width that shows a column's title and what is on the screen of its values.

23060.name: custom
23060.docs: The effect is `map(t)`, where `t` runs from 0 to 1 over the window, after easing.

21825.name: opens
21825.docs: A mark opens after the start, a space or punctuation, right against what it marks.

11580.name: expanded_rows
11580.docs: The rows with details open, by index in the data, to keep or to set from outside.

4532.name: viewports
4532.docs: Frame size of each scroll container in the last layout.

26330.name: VIEWPORT_MARGIN
26330.docs: How far a layer in a corner of the window keeps from its edges.

12234.name: ValueFilter
12234.docs: A column's filter by value: a list of what is in it, to check.

16085.name: from_texts
16085.docs: The texts of a catalog, in its language. What it does not have comes from English.

14196.name: CompareSide
14196.docs: One of the two pictures of a [`CompareView`].

14850.name: fit_scale
14850.docs: The scale that shows the whole content in the view.

11653.name: STRIPED_ROW
11653.docs:
Room for one button of a [`GridRowAction`].
How much of the theme's control color a shaded row shows.

22552.name: events
22552.docs: The bars. Those on no row are ignored.

2716.name: Left
2716.docs: The middle of the left edge.

7221.name: GUTTER_GAP
7221.docs: Room between the line numbers and the code.

4024.name: RichFn
4024.docs: Draws a node with [`PaintCx`], given its absolute frame.

4678.name: text
4678.docs: Creates a text leaf that wraps to the width its parent offers.

1481.name: item_colors
1481.docs: Gives the categories these colors, in order, over those of the series.

20809.name: new
20809.docs: A name bound to `value`, which changes only when the new name is confirmed.

14415.name: Histogram

25968.name: ROOT_ID
25968.docs: Id of the window node; widget-derived ids never collide with it in practice.

11872.name: original
11872.docs: The layout as it first was, to come back to.

2281.name: move_by_handle
2281.docs:
Makes `handle` move something placed anywhere, by dragging and with the arrow keys. While
it is dragged the place stays in `dragging`, and goes to `place` only at the end, since the
app may write it to a file.

17031.name: Measured
17031.docs: Laid out and then read back; until then, this estimate.

11291.name: totals
11291.docs: Gives the aggregates per column for the footer.

26041.name: touches
26041.docs: Whether anything `frame` draws, with its margin, can land inside `clip`.

11945.name: drop_before
11945.docs: Where a dragged column would land.

15796.name: wizard_progress
15796.docs:
Where a [`Wizard`](crate::Wizard) stands, where `{0}` is its step and `{1}` its count.
[`Labels::wizard_progress`] fills it in.

17104.name: ListProbe
17104.docs: What a list found out in its last build, for the view around it.

17758.name: limit
17758.docs: The most options asked for at a time. 50 by default.

25460.name: movable
25460.docs: It can be dragged along its track.

15869.name: diagnostics_report_questions
15869.docs: The start of a new bug report: the questions for the person to answer.

24879.name: caret_follows_end
24879.docs: A caret at the end stays there when a change makes the text longer.

17831.name: looping
17831.docs: Whether it starts over at the end, or stays on its last frame.

7586.name: disabled
7586.docs: Turns the picker off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

11437.name: DataGrid

4389.name: wheel_sideways
4389.docs: A wheel that only turns up and down moves this scroll container sideways.

16596.name: new
16596.docs:
The folder at `path`, from the root, with `entries` inside it. Keep the entries in an
`Rc` between builds when they are many: they are sorted again only when they are not the
same ones.

22409.name: locked
22409.docs: Stops it being moved or resized.

26260.name: is_dragging
26260.docs:
True while a pointer drag that started on a draggable element (a slider,
a splitter) is in progress. Touch platforms use it to tell drags from scrolls.

12164.name: first_draft
12164.docs: What the formula field starts with.

23063.name: fade_out
23063.docs: Fades out and lifts 24 pixels away.

18631.name: popup
18631.docs:
How floating panels appear: from the side of their anchor.

Quick and without a spring: a spring's tail keeps the scale changing by fractions of a
pixel, and the text shivers. It comes in solid, since a panel fading in would show
what is behind it through its fields, and leaves as one surface.

11583.name: page_size
11583.docs: Shows the rows a page at a time, with a pager at the bottom.

23136.name: length
23136.docs: How many pixels of scrolling the content stays pinned.

16088.name: dock_place_lower
16088.docs: A place in the middle of a sentence.

23790.name: EDGE_ARROW_LEAST_STEP
23790.docs: The least an arrow of a [`ScrollEdgeArrow`] scrolls, in logical pixels.

13545.name: pivot_point
13545.docs: The point it turns around, in the units of the content.

25098.name: tiles
25098.docs: Things side by side: tiles to rearrange, and cards in as many columns as fit.

103.name: Small
103.docs: 32 px tall, smaller text; dense toolbars and table rows.

11002.name: expression_of
11002.docs:
The expression in a filter-row text, when it is one: it parses and every field it reads is a
column title. Any other text, such as `[draft]`, stays a short filter, and so does anything a
row cannot answer on its own: aggregates, parameters and functions the grid does not register.

14853.name: zoomed
14853.docs: At another scale, with the point of the content at `anchor` in the view staying there.

11075.name: formula_value
11075.docs: What a formula comes to over these rows.

4681.name: empty
4681.docs: An empty box that takes no space.

1484.name: dots
1484.docs: Draws a dot on each point of a line or a radar.

6643.name: dock_size
6643.docs:
How large a dock gets out of `room`, and how large it could get while the center and `taken`
keep theirs.

7297.name: grouping
7297.docs: Whether thousands are separated without focus. On by default.

7951.name: Carousel
7951.docs: Slides with previous/next buttons, position dots and optional autoplay.

20812.name: on_click
20812.docs:
What a single click on the name does, such as selecting its row, since the name
takes the clicks that land on it.

21466.name: search
21466.docs: A "Tell me what you want to do" search box.

22120.name: time
22120.docs: The time axis and how events share a row, with no UI.

25971.name: perform_action
25971.docs:
Performs an action assistive technology asked for on the node with
this id (from the latest [`Ui::access_tree`]). Returns true if the UI
needs a redraw.

15726.name: DocumentTabs

23428.name: speak
23428.docs:
Says `text` with the system's voice for `language`, in place of anything
still being said.

2284.name: at
2284.docs: Where it is now, and the limits of where it can go.

6135.name: placed
6135.docs: Places a node exactly where the geometry says.

395.name: Calendar

26044.name: placements
26044.docs: Times every element was given its place.

5554.name: icon
5554.docs: Shows an icon before the text.

16453.name: modified_order
16453.docs: What sorts the dates, as a number that grows with time.

17761.name: disabled
17761.docs: Turns the lookup off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

10713.name: field
10713.docs: The name of the field this column shows, which stays when the title is translated.

468.name: KeyHandler
468.docs: Called with the focused element's key presses; returns true when it handled the key.

12021.name: Group
12021.docs: Group by it, at this place among the groups.

17834.name: alt
17834.docs: What screen readers say it shows. Without it, it is decoration they skip.

11440.name: new
11440.docs: Rows that `loader` brings, in chunks of 100, keeping 8 of them.

4392.name: PickedFile
4392.docs: A file brought into the app, whole, in memory.

15291.name: small
15291.docs: A smaller switch, 32 by 18 logical pixels instead of 40 by 24, for dense lists.

26190.name: glide
26190.docs: A scroll gliding to an anchor: which container, from and to, and when it began.

16599.name: mode
16599.docs: How entries can be selected ([`SelectionMode::Multiple`] by default).

14710.name: brightness
14710.docs: How bright the disc is drawn, from 0 to 1 (1 by default). It changes only the look.

15364.name: pop_mark

106.name: StatusBar
106.docs:
The one line at the foot of an app window that is always there: the version,
what is going on in the background, a notice with its actions.

Where a [`Footer`] ends a page and wraps or stacks to show everything, a
status bar keeps one fixed line: its sides keep their width and the center
takes the rest, cutting what does not fit, so it never pushes the app around.
Tinting the center with [`Self::center_tone`] makes a notice stand out without
the whole bar shouting. The center is announced to screen readers as a status.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{StatusBar, Tone, ViewExt};

let bar = StatusBar::new()
    .left((StatusBar::action("Version 1.2"),))
    .center((StatusBar::text("Version 1.3 is available").truncate().grow(1.0), StatusBar::action("Update")))
    .center_tone(Tone::Warning)
    .right((StatusBar::text("12 items"),));
```

15680.name: SankeyChart
15680.docs:
How much flows from what to what. Each [`flow`](Self::flow) names its two ends, and
nodes are created as they are named. Ribbons go from the color of their source to
that of their target; under the pointer or with the arrow keys, what is connected
stands out and the tooltip says how much. A screen reader hears every flow.

If the flows go in a circle there is no way to draw them, and it says which nodes
the circle goes through, in place of the diagram. Available with the `charts`
feature, on by default.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::SankeyChart;

let budget = SankeyChart::new()
    .title("Budget")
    .flow("Salary", "Rent", 1200.0)
    .flow("Salary", "Food", 600.0)
    .flow("Salary", "Savings", 400.0)
    .flow("Savings", "Funds", 400.0);
```

is, under the pointer or with the arrow keys. [`ChartKind::Scatter`] and the
sparklines stay as plain pictures, which take no focus, until given a
[`tooltip`](Self::tooltip).

Available with the `charts` feature, on by default.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Chart, ChartKind};

let sales = Chart::new(ChartKind::Line)
    .title("Sales")
    .categories(["Jan", "Feb", "Mar"])
    .series("2025", [12.0, 18.0, 15.0])
    .series("2026", [14.0, 21.0, 26.0])
    .height(240.0);
```

15917.docs: The menu of commands that did not fit.

1821.name: new
1821.docs: A code of this format holding `data`.

13374.name: grow
13374.docs:
How much of the free space along the parent stack it takes: 1 by default, or 0 over a
[stage](Self::stage), which then decides the size.

14028.name: label
14028.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

11485.name: Multiple
11485.docs: Check boxes; Ctrl/Cmd-click toggles, Shift-click selects a range.

26235.name: set_phase_clock
26235.docs:
Measures the phases with `clock`, which tells the seconds. Without a clock,
which is the default, measuring costs nothing. WebAssembly has no clock of its
own, so it is the platform that passes one in.

5091.name: new
5091.docs: A column with this header title, weight 1.0, left-aligned.

7053.name: tidy
7053.docs: Back to the simplest form after any change.

5.name: ButtonStyle

8361.name: description
8361.docs: What screen readers say after its name.

5818.name: message
5818.docs: An alert that is only its message, for when a title would just repeat where it is.

18679.name: nav
18679.docs: Navigation: tabs, sidebars, breadcrumbs and disclosures.

15482.name: paint_color_track
15482.docs:
Draws a track through `colors`. Gradients have two stops and square ends: one for each
pair of colors, between round caps in the end colors.

23838.name: EdgeArrow
23838.docs: One arrow of a [`ScrollEdgeArrow`], which any view that scrolls by itself can also use.

20641.name: MOST_LINES
20641.docs: The most lines the console keeps, the oldest going first.

21295.name: Large
21295.docs: A tall button: large icon above a (wrapping) label.

18098.name: width
18098.docs: Fixes the width in logical pixels.

4656.name: anchor
4656.docs:
Marks the node as the place `#name` links scroll to, landing `offset` pixels
below the top of its scroll container (the height of a bar pinned over it).

1459.name: categories
1459.docs: What each point is about: the labels along the bottom, or of each slice.

16209.name: take_anchor
16209.docs: The anchor a link asked for, once.

13012.name: ContentSpace
13012.docs:
How the coordinates of a widget drawn over content relate to the screen, so that a selection
or a crop is told in the units of the content whatever the zoom.

23911.name: right
23911.docs: The views at the right end.

7272.name: ClipboardAccess
7272.docs: How a field treats the clipboard.

4729.name: overlay
4729.docs:
Builds `view` as a floating layer above the rest of the UI, placed relative
to `anchor`. `on_dismiss` is called on a click outside the layer and its
anchor, or on Escape.

1532.name: tooltip_panel
1532.docs: What a tooltip says about a category.

23984.name: leading
23984.docs: Any view before the title, such as an icon or a menu.

6691.name: Bottom
6691.docs: The strip under the center, between the columns.

3494.docs:
Runs the command with these keys, also from the overflow menu's place, and
shows them there. Off while the command is disabled.

14393.name: lightbox_chip
14393.docs: A chip over the picture: on the surface of the theme, which keeps its words readable.

15701.name: selection_none
15701.docs: What a [`SelectionBar`](crate::SelectionBar) says with nothing chosen.

8653.name: choosable
8653.docs:
Makes the whole zone a button that opens the system's chooser, with a click, Enter or
Space, so that the keyboard can bring files too. Leave it off when the content has
its own way of choosing.

14466.name: share
14466.docs: The share of the channel in one bin, or zero for an empty channel.

15774.name: InlineRename

23476.name: grow
23476.docs:
Takes a share of the free space in the parent stack. A growing
stack may also shrink below its content (CSS `min-height: 0`), so
scroll views inside it get a bounded height.

2986.name: read_text
2986.docs:
The clipboard's text, or `None` when it is empty, not text, or cannot
be read synchronously (in the browser, pasting arrives as typed text).

13885.name: space
13885.docs: Where the content is, and so the units of its coordinates: by default, its own box.

25438.name: timeline
25438.docs:
Things along time, on tracks: the timeline of a video or audio editor, and of
anything else planned in milliseconds.

4294.name: new
4294.docs: A node with this role, named by its content when the role allows it.

4948.name: transcript_part
4948.docs: The button to read what was said, or to ask for it.

15847.name: diagnostics_causes
15847.docs: Diagnostics panel: the names of the causes, in the order of `BuildCause::ALL`.

23549.name: align
23549.docs:
Where the smaller layers go, along both axes. `Stretch`, the default, gives them the
whole width and puts them at the top.

5602.name: border
5602.docs:
Draws a ring of `width` logical pixels, as on the selected one of a row. A picture
shrinks to fit inside it.

2405.name: ORB_KEY
2405.docs: Keeps the sphere's state while the panel comes and goes around it.

10107.name: pinned
10107.docs: It stays in place at the left while the others scroll.

14612.name: marker
14612.docs: Marks this value in units, such as where the pointer is.

19771.name: HelpPanel
19771.docs: What a [`HelpTip`] opens: what something is and, if it helps, how to use it.

1824.name: hide_text
1824.docs: Leaves out the text under the bars of a linear code.

589.name: today
589.docs: Marks this day with a ring in the calendars.

26238.name: stats
26238.docs: What this runtime has done so far.

15993.name: expression_error_at
15993.docs: Where a syntax error is, with `{line}` and `{column}` in it.

19844.name: placement
19844.docs: Where it opens relative to the anchor ([`Placement::Below`] by default).

17301.name: label
17301.docs: What screen readers say of the day.

17955.name: nothing_fits
17955.docs: When no model fits this machine.

662.name: grow
662.docs: Fills the free space along the parent stack's axis.

19263.name: rail_separator
19263.docs: What stands for a caption when only icons are left.

16066.name: playground_last_good
16066.docs: The result a [`Playground`](crate::Playground) keeps while the code has problems.

15485.name: SliderTrack
15485.docs:
The part of a [`Slider`] that is dragged. Its own view when the value sits beside it, so
that hover and focus are about the track.

8437.name: extensions
8437.docs: The extensions offered, such as `pdf`; empty offers every file.

12942.name: stretch
12942.docs: Stretches across the parent stack (height follows the aspect ratio unless set).

13596.name: Bottom
13596.docs: The middle of the bottom side.

21298.name: RibbonSize
21298.docs: How much room a ribbon command takes.

18101.name: stretch
18101.docs: Stretches across the parent stack's cross axis.

808.name: LIFT_SOLID_FROM
808.docs: How much a slice's way forward it takes it to be solid.

15558.name: label
15558.docs: The name screen readers announce for the group, such as "Density".

4659.name: QuadField

13015.name: placed
13015.docs: Where the whole content lands on screen, for a widget at `frame`.

17520.name: with_registry
17520.docs: A runner over a registry of the app's own, such as one with more types added.

227.name: NodeId
227.docs:
A node of the element tree produced by one build. Only valid during the
build that created it.

12434.name: even
12434.docs: Second, fourth and so on since the last group row.

16285.name: id
16285.docs: What identifies it, whatever its place.

23987.name: on_maximize
23987.docs: Shows the maximize button, which runs `handler`, as a double click on the bar does.

16939.name: Extents
16939.docs: How long each piece is along the strip, written by the pieces as they are laid out.

13742.name: made_to_fit
13742.docs:
Made smaller until it fits, and moved first if that alone would leave almost nothing: a
crop against the edge of the content would otherwise vanish as it turns.

300.name: IconButton
300.docs: A square, icon-only button (ghost by default), for toolbars.

11199.name: culture
11199.docs: The language and region of numbers and dates, such as `pt-BR`.

26603.docs:
Marks the step as having a problem, in the row of steps at the top, whichever
step is showing. It does not stop anyone from leaving it: [`Self::check`] does.

8656.docs: Only these extensions, such as `["pdf", "png"]`. Any file by default.

9964.name: Shared
9964.docs: A view shown in more than one build, by a parent that takes ownership.

25368.name: card_width
25368.docs: The narrowest a card gets; they share what is left over. 240 by default.

15123.name: scaled
15123.docs: The content's size on screen at a scale.

9383.name: held_back
9383.docs: Fades in `node` once `held` turns false, keeping its place until then.

10037.name: Remembered
10037.docs: Only remembers the request, for tests and headless use.

2989.name: ClipboardProvider
2989.docs:
Reads and writes the system clipboard. Platform layers install one with
[`crate::Ui::set_clipboard`]; until then, an in-memory clipboard is used.

13888.name: aspect
13888.docs: Holds this width over height for every handle.

6840.name: tabs
6840.docs: A group of these panels, with the first one showing.

25441.name: TICK_ROOM
25441.docs: Labels on the ruler stay at least this far apart, in logical pixels.

22244.name: width
22244.docs: The whole width, in logical pixels.

4297.name: name
4297.docs: Sets the accessible name, replacing the name from content.

22898.name: Lanes
22898.docs: The empty part of the timeline: draws a new event, and holds the bars.

15850.name: diagnostics_memory
15850.docs: Diagnostics panel: the GPU's resources and memory.

2408.name: choice
2408.docs: Toggle buttons, toggle groups, pagination, labels and aspect-ratio boxes.

24206.name: first
24206.docs: Where this place's tools start, counting every tool of the rail.

14615.name: whole_units
14615.docs: Never divides below one unit, for what comes in whole pieces, such as pixels.

519.name: label
519.docs:
The name screen readers announce, such as "Due date". Inside a
[`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

22971.docs:
The element coming in: 0 when its top reaches the bottom edge, 1 when it is fully
visible (or, if taller than the view, when its top reaches the top edge).

15923.docs: After the count of events an [`EventCalendar`](crate::EventCalendar) day has no room for.

2481.name: toggle_item
2481.docs: The look shared by toggle buttons and toggle group items.

24933.name: at
24933.docs: A caret at `at` with nothing selected.

15996.name: expression_operators
15996.docs:
The operators an [`ExpressionEditor`](crate::ExpressionEditor) lists: what it inserts
and what it does.

19847.name: min_width
19847.docs: The narrowest the panel gets, in logical pixels (220 by default).

2554.name: Pagination
2554.docs: Page navigation: Previous, numbered pages with ellipses, Next.

3208.name: color_picker
3208.docs: Choosing a color: a field that opens a palette, a shade square and a hue bar.

14107.name: new
14107.docs: A crop bound to `area`, in the units of its [space](Self::space).

25006.name: edit
25006.docs:
Applies a key to `text` and the cursor: typing, deleting, moving (Shift
extends the selection; Alt or Ctrl moves by word; Cmd moves to the ends),
select all, and copy, cut and paste with Cmd or Ctrl. Returns false for
keys the field does not handle, including a paste the clipboard cannot
read synchronously (the browser then delivers it as typed text).

17958.name: ModelPickerLabels
17958.docs: The words a [`ModelPicker`] shows. English by default.

1319.name: horizontal
1319.docs: Bars lie down, with their categories on the left.

16069.docs: Saves what the code of a [`Playground`](crate::Playground) makes as a file to keep.

5824.name: tone
5824.docs: Sets the color tone and icon.

20574.name: example
20574.docs: An example to start from, listed in the bar; the first one fills the editor.

14834.name: ZOOM_STOPS
14834.docs: Where zoom steps stop, as screen pixels per unit of content.

18685.name: tab
18685.docs: Adds a tab with this label and content.

12945.docs:
The image going out, if one is, and when it started. Kept by this view, because the
app only ever hands over the current one.

18104.name: tooltip
18104.docs: Shows `text` above the view while the pointer is over it; see [`Tooltip`].

157.name: control_colors
157.docs: Fill, label color and border of a control for a style and interaction state.

7859.name: back
7859.docs:
How many characters before the end of `insert` the caret lands, such as inside
a function's parentheses.

18758.docs:
Width of a sidebar reduced to icons, in logical pixels. It keeps each icon
where it was when the sidebar is open: padding, row padding, icon, and back.

13018.name: to_content
13018.docs: A point on screen, in the units of the content.

3427.name: Hotkey

16288.name: unsaved
16288.docs: It has changes that were not saved.

23990.name: maximized
23990.docs: The window is maximized: the maximize button shows and says that it restores.

16942.name: key_target
16942.docs: Where a key moves a piece: Alt with an arrow one place, and Alt with Home or End to the ends.

9894.name: form_layout
9894.docs: Arranging the fields of a form: groups, columns, tabs and what is wrong.

24644.docs:
A separator for `day`: the words for today and yesterday from
[`Labels`](crate::Labels), and otherwise the short date.

6697.name: ALL_IN_MENU
6697.docs: All four, in the order a menu lists them.

11202.name: group_by
11202.docs: The column rows are grouped by, by its index in [`columns`](Self::columns).

15707.name: audio_loading
15707.docs: A recording is on its way.

8659.name: label
8659.docs: The name screen readers announce. By default, the words of the hint.

2919.name: required
2919.docs: Adds a red `*` after the text.

25371.name: selection_mode
25371.docs: How cards are selected. One at a time by default.

15126.name: on_frame
15126.docs:
One frame of a gesture, from paint: it needs no build, and when nothing else reads the
view, none happens until the gesture ends.

13891.name: rotatable
13891.docs: Whether it can be turned by the handle above it (it can by default).

22247.name: snap_minutes
22247.docs:
The smallest step an event moves by: a quarter of an hour on the hour
scale, a day on the others.

4300.name: numeric
4300.docs: Sets a numeric value and its range.

15853.name: diagnostics_test_cause_interface
15853.docs: A performance test blames building the screen.

The rows behind a data grid. Cloning shares the same data; editing replaces
the row list copy-on-write, so query caches stay valid until a change.

Places overlapping stretches of time on lanes, the earliest first, so none
overlaps another on its lane. Returns each one's lane, in the order given, and
how many lanes there are; at least one.

4373.name: text_color
4373.docs: Color of the text this element shows, if it is a text leaf.

15926.name: zoom_in
15926.docs: Zooms a scheduler's time axis in.

26825.name: on_select
26825.docs:

position, 0 being the first.

595.name: read_only
595.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

26244.docs:
Hands dropped files to the place under `position`. When no place is there, and the
screen has only one, it goes there: not every system says where a drop landed.
Whether anything took them.

15999.name: grid_edit_filter
15999.docs: Opens the editor of a grid's whole filter.

2557.name: new
2557.docs: `page` is zero-based; `pages` is the total count.

14110.name: guide
14110.docs: The lines inside the frame, or none (thirds by default).

25009.name: theme
25009.docs: Choosing a theme, and changing its tokens.

17961.name: from_texts

11567.docs: How a cell looks, by what its row holds. Colors come from the theme.

1322.name: ChartBarFrom
1322.docs: Where the bars of a [`Chart`] grow from.

16072.name: playground_problems
16072.docs: The problems of the code of a [`Playground`](crate::Playground).

20577.name: language
20577.docs: The language the editor colors; Rust by default.

21231.name: dirty
21231.docs: Set by [`UiWaker::wake`] and cleared by the build it causes.

21885.name: strike_on
21885.docs: The strike goes on over the space after it.

14837.name: scale
14837.docs: Screen pixels per unit of content: 1 is 100%.

18688.name: new
18688.docs: Empty tabs; `selected` holds the zero-based index of the open tab.

4592.name: hover_readers
4592.docs: The views that asked about the pointer, so that it moving elsewhere rebuilds nothing.

5900.name: delta
5900.docs: A change such as `"+12.4%"`; `up` picks the color and arrow.

9751.name: fuzzy_match
9751.docs: Is every character of `query` found in order in `text`? (case-insensitive)

13602.name: share
13602.docs: Where it sits, as a share of the box.

24501.name: color
24501.docs: Uses this color instead of the tone's.

17453.name: generic_functions
17453.docs: `Text::bound(&state, |value| ..)`: generic over the state's type, so written out here.

18761.name: SIDEBAR_BRAND_INSET
18761.docs: Puts a brand's 26px mark in line with the icons of a rail.

4665.name: on_file_drop
4665.docs: Makes the node take files dropped on it.

19415.name: expanded
19415.docs: Whether the submenu is unfolded, for a row with one.

2122.name: Conversation
2122.docs: The messages, scrolled to the newest when one arrives.

5973.name: TOGGLE
5973.docs: How thick the strip that collapses a dock is.

16872.name: Sheet
16872.docs: A sheet with its picture, or the promise of one.

24574.name: active
24574.docs: Turns the light on or off, as the work starts and ends, without moving the text.

16945.name: marker
16945.docs:
The line that marks the target, for a piece to carry at its start or at its end. It stays
out of the flow, so showing it moves nothing.

9897.name: MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH
9897.docs: A field narrower than this moves to a line of its own, wherever the form is.

2849.name: defaults
2849.docs: Adds a button that puts these colors back.

306.name: label
306.docs:
Sets the name screen readers announce, such as "Search". Without it,
the icon's name is used, which rarely describes the action well.

4157.name: Described
4157.docs: What is on screen, as asked for with [`BuildCx::ask_for_access_tree`].

15710.name: audio_transcribing
15710.docs: What was said in a recording is on its way.

8662.name: no_hint
8662.docs: Shows nothing over the content while files are over the window, only the stronger edge.

25374.name: card_name
25374.docs: What a screen reader says for each card, since the card's content is free.

15783.name: image_replace
15783.docs: Opens the chooser of an [`ImageField`](crate::ImageField) that has a picture.

13240.name: pressed
13240.docs: Where the drag began, in units of the content.

2995.name: clipboard
2995.docs: The system clipboard, as a service the platform layer provides.

13894.name: on_commit
13894.docs: Runs `handler` with the result when a drag ends or a key changes it: one step to undo.

15856.name: diagnostics_unoptimized
15856.docs: Diagnostics: the app was built without optimizations.

15929.name: histogram_clipped_low
15929.docs: What a [`Histogram`](crate::Histogram) says when a channel piles up at its low end.

26247.name: viewport
26247.docs: The viewport size in logical pixels.

16002.name: grid_scenario_save
16002.docs: Saves how a grid is arranged, under a new name.

12805.name: glyph
12805.docs: The character that draws this icon in the RavenIcons font.

21161.name: links

Adds a heading over links, after what is already there: each a label and what
clicking it does, such as opening the issue a change came from.

14113.name: on_commit
14113.docs: Runs `handler` with the result when a drag ends or a key changes it: one step to undo.

19272.name: collapsible
19272.docs:
Lets the caption fold the group. Reduced to icons, a group is always
unfolded, because its caption is gone.

20580.name: action
20580.docs: A button in the bar that gets the code as it is.

14840.name: Minimap

Keeps the open tab from changing, such as while waiting for an answer that
belongs to it. The bar fades and the tabs ignore input.

2052.name: examples
2052.docs: Things to ask, offered as buttons before the first message.

20653.name: new
20653.docs:
A field of `columns × rows` squares forming the picture `picture(u, v, seconds)`,
where `u` and `v` run from 0 to 1 across and down.

17456.name: canvas
17456.docs:
`Canvas::new(|frame, scene| ..)`: the closure draws into a scene of its own, which is then
added to the real one, as a `&mut Scene` cannot leave the paint.

14259.name: label
14259.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

817.name: ValueColor
817.docs: The color of a value in a tooltip, given its series and the value.

4668.name: is_hovered
4668.docs: The pointer is over this view's interactive element.

1471.name: series_icon
1471.docs: Gives the series called `name` an icon, for the legend and the tooltip.

13024.name: watch
13024.docs: Makes the build that calls it follow the view.

9827.name: fill
9827.docs: Takes the width of its parent, as other fields of a form do.

2779.name: cell_size
2779.docs: Sets the side of a square in logical pixels (10 by default).

24577.name: new
24577.docs: `text` with the light passing over it.

14332.name: new
14332.docs: A lightbox over these pictures, shown while `open` holds the index of one.

25231.name: at
25231.docs: The cell under a point inside the layout.

8011.name: SPLIT_STEP
8011.docs: How far an arrow key moves the bar between panes, in logical pixels.

15713.name: chat_photo_loading
15713.docs: A photo in a [`Chat`](crate::Chat) is on its way.

8665.name: min_height
8665.docs: The shortest it gets, in logical pixels.

24723.name: allow_new

7430.name: Time

15786.name: TileLayout

6849.name: remove
6849.docs: Takes the panel out, and says who stayed in its group. It can leave a group empty.

14551.name: scale
14551.docs: How counts turn into heights (`Linear` by default).

15859.name: diagnostics_no_gpu
15859.docs: Diagnostics: no GPU could be used.

22326.name: AUTO_SCROLL_EDGE
22326.docs: A drag this close to an edge of the timeline scrolls it.

26177.name: time
26177.docs: Seconds since start, set by the platform.

2490.name: multiple

3798.name: ask

22399.name: tone
22399.docs: Its color; say what it means in the title or next to the scheduler too.

26250.name: set_theme
26250.docs: Switches the theme; components can do the same through `BuildCx::theme_state`.

8303.name: Rule

16005.name: grid_scenario_original

23707.name: Spacer
23707.docs: Flexible empty space that pushes its siblings apart inside a stack.

9611.name: show_until_closed
9611.docs: Shows a toast that stays until a person closes it or [`Self::dismiss`] does.

25015.name: ThemePicker

A menu of themes that says which one is on, small enough for a sidebar's footer or a
toolbar. For the three of them side by side, in a settings page, see
[`ThemeSwitcher`](crate::ThemeSwitcher).

11573.name: new
11573.docs: A grid over `data` with these columns; single selection, filter row, toolbar and footer on.

19275.name: DropdownMenu
19275.docs:
A button that opens a list of actions. The first item takes focus as the
menu opens; arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes, and focus returns
to the button.

12227.name: values_of
12227.docs: The distinct values of a column, with what the filter menu shows for each.

16078.name: playground_more
16078.docs: The menu of a narrow [`Playground`](crate::Playground) with what is not Run.

while typing.

skip formatting its numbers.

Double-click or Enter on a row, with the row's values. Works the same over

16896.docs: How far the pointer goes before a press becomes a drag, so a click stays a click.

7305.name: read_only

Makes every location but the current page a link: a click, Enter or Space runs

15734.name: dock_center

Keeps whether it is open in this binding, so the app decides and can remember it.

panel is already what it would become.

22855.name: frame

15807.name: no_commands
15807.docs: A command palette's search that found nothing.

23509.name: new

16461.name: modified

24163.name: RAIL_ICON_BUTTON

10721.name: sortable

15880.name: LookupField

4400.name: measure

26198.name: painted_palette

15953.name: compare_first

13410.docs:
What an [`Eyedropper`] and an [`EyedropperArea`] share, and how a color reaches them: from
the area, or from whoever knows the color under the pointer through [`pick`](Self::pick).

17915.name: ModelPicker

A choice of local AI models, however many there are, to download, try, use and remove. It shows what it is
given: deciding which models fit and doing the work is up to the app, or to
`ravenrs-ai`.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{ModelChoice, ModelPicker, ModelStatus};

let picker = ModelPicker::new(vec![ModelChoice {
    name: "Small model".into(),
    details: "1.1 GB · Apache 2.0".into(),
    status: ModelStatus::Available,
    in_use: false,
    result: None,
    error: None,
}])
.on_download(|index| println!("download {index}"));
```

25617.name: pixels_per_second
25617.docs: How wide a second is, in logical pixels (28 by default).

15372.name: label
15372.docs: The name screen readers announce for the group, such as "Plan".

26271.name: modal_layers
26271.docs: A modal layer and what is above it: a menu opened from it counts as inside it.

8324.name: note_text

12175.name: SummaryEditor
12175.docs: Edits what a column sums up: one of the usual kinds, or a formula.

10286.name: Summary
10286.docs: An aggregate shown in group rows and in the footer.

Lets the Delete key and a toolbar button remove the selected rows. The handler
receives them, and it decides: it may ask first.

15445.name: width

5200.name: first_of_month

16099.name: moved_to_position
16099.docs: What is announced after a reorder, such as "Moved to position 2 of 5".

23801.name: height

16753.name: mode

18061.name: width
18061.docs: Fixes the width in logical pixels.

7816.name: field
7816.docs: Offers a field, written `[name]`; a dotted name reads a nested value.

22566.name: on_create
22566.docs: A stretch of time was drawn on a row, by dragging or double-clicking.

26417.name: wire_with
26417.docs:
Like [`Self::wire`], with `before` seeing keys first (a menubar title
opens its menu with Down; menu items switch menus with Left and Right).

5273.name: VIEWS_SHOWN
5273.docs: How many views the panel lists.

10432.name: grid
10432.docs:
An enterprise-style data grid: [`DataGrid`] over [`GridData`] with
[`GridColumn`]s. The query pipeline in [`query`] is pure and usable on its own.

25182.docs:
Puts each tile in the first place it fits, going row by row: `(column, row)`.
A tile wider than the grid takes the whole width.

7235.name: code
7235.docs: Shows the text as code. Only `CodeEditor`, of the `code` feature, asks for it.

187.name: style
187.docs: Sets the visual emphasis (`Primary` by default).

14937.docs:

the range of the [`ZoomPanView`] that shares the view.

unless [`Self::value_domain`] fixed it.

4111.name: fraction_x

9270.name: description

When motion is reduced, or while [`active`](Self::active) is off, it is plain muted text
that asks for no frames.

let waiting = ShimmerText::new("Looking for updates");
```

24893.name: end_aligned

11165.name: GridTable

26788.name: note

picture given by `picture` when it shows. Asked only for what shows, on each build, so it
should hand over what is ready and start on what is not.

20686.name: SLIDER_WIDTH

17489.name: LiveCx
17489.docs:
What the program's `build` gets as `cx`: its states, kept between builds in order, the time,
and the view it hands to `cx.child`.

21340.name: ribbon
21340.docs:
An Office-style ribbon: application
menu, Quick Access Toolbar, pages (tabs) with groups of large and small
commands, contextual page categories, search, and a collapsed mode.

196.name: shortcut
196.docs:
Shows a key cap after the label, in the label's color, such as `"F8"`. It only
shows the key: [`BuildCx::shortcut`] makes the key work.

4701.name: key
4701.docs:
The node's identity among the motions of its view. Defaults to call
order, so use it for nodes built in a loop whose items come and go.

1504.name: concentric
1504.docs: One ring per series in a pie, instead of only the first series.

23302.name: new
23302.docs: A line with no hints yet.

9860.name: search_row
9860.docs: One option under a search box: what a [`Combobox`] and a lookup list show.

17562.name: FIELD_MIN_WIDTH
17562.docs: The least it can show, since it fills what it is in unless given a width.

22067.name: node_color
22067.docs: Gives this node a color of the theme, in place of the next chart color.

923.name: Reveal
923.docs: From the left across, as a pen would: lines, areas, dots and candles.

24029.name: text
24029.docs: Text in a status bar's usual look: small and muted.

6082.name: DockSide
6082.docs: One of the four places a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea) has.

9933.name: field
9933.docs: Appends a field, in the next free column.

7390.name: keep_literals
7390.docs: The binding holds the text as shown, with the pattern's own characters.

342.name: DateRange
342.docs: Two days and the days between them, both included.

11241.name: QUERY_SETTLE
11241.docs: Seconds typing in a filter must rest before the data is asked for again.

996.name: appear_key_of
996.docs: What a chart's key to draw in again comes down to.

15746.name: dock_resize_pair
15746.docs: The bar between two parts of a split, with `{first}` and `{second}`.

9352.name: logo
9352.docs:
Shows the app's own artwork above the name, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image).
It replaces [`Self::icon`].

13203.name: size
13203.docs: Fixed size in logical pixels, instead of taking the free space.

3612.name: fill
3612.docs: Takes the free space of the parent, for content that fills a stage or a whole screen.

15819.name: theme_restore
15819.docs: Goes back to the theme as it came.

26718.name: new
26718.docs: The mark of the step with this number, not reached yet.

1723.name: ChartCard

13276.name: space
13276.docs: Where the content is, and so the units of its coordinates: by default, its own box.

24175.name: icons_only
24175.docs: Shows only icons, with the names as tooltips.

20978.name: new
20978.docs: A rule at this frequency, every time, with no end.

24829.name: foreground
24829.docs: Text color, as a theme role (`Ink` by default) or a literal color.

10733.name: display_summary
10733.docs: Formats an aggregate of this column.

6301.name: dock_key
6301.docs: Which dock Alt and Shift with an arrow send a panel to.

14657.name: color
14657.docs: The color this is, at this brightness.

4412.name: progress_out
4412.docs: Told the scroll progress along this range before each paint.

15965.name: recurrence_ends_name
15965.docs: What says when a rule stops.

1869.name: on_open
1869.docs:
Makes a photo or a document open with a click, Enter or Space: for instance in an
[`ImageLightbox`](crate::ImageLightbox), or through the system.

2523.name: Roving
2523.docs:
Roving focus for item `index` of `count` in a row or column (radio buttons,
tabs, toolbar buttons, menu items): arrow keys move focus to the neighbor,
wrapping; Home and End jump to the ends.

16692.name: ARROW_LENGTH
16692.docs: How long an arrow at the end of the strip is.

6447.name: BORDER_ZONE
6447.docs: How close to the border of the area a drop means a dock that is not showing.

14803.name: label
14803.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

11606.name: horizontal_lines
11606.docs: Whether a line separates the rows. On by default.

7828.name: status
7828.docs: What the check says about `text`, if anything.

4631.name: FilePicker
4631.docs: A shared handle to the file chooser, from [`crate::BuildCx::file_picker`].

19381.name: action
19381.docs:
Adds a control at the end of the row, beside its button: usually a small
[`IconButton`] with a label, or a [`DropdownMenu`](crate::DropdownMenu).
Hidden when reduced to icons.

16838.name: height
16838.docs: A fixed height. It takes the height its parent gives it by default.

20689.name: FIELD_WIDTH
20689.docs: The width of the number field of [`ValueSlider::field`], in logical pixels.

24540.name: label
24540.docs: What the bars are, as a whole, for screen readers.

10444.name: as_f64
10444.docs: The numeric value: numbers as is, booleans as 0.0 or 1.0, otherwise `None`.

853.name: picture_of
853.docs: The picture of these layers, drawn now only if none is kept.

8555.name: size_text
8555.docs: A size as people read it.

1507.name: no_spokes
1507.docs: Leaves out the lines from the center of a radar chart.

22070.name: no_appear
22070.docs:
The flows are whole from the first frame, instead of drawing in from the left
the first time the chart is painted.

15676.name: candle_open
15676.docs: Where a candle of a [`Chart`](crate::Chart) opened.

24032.name: center
24032.docs:
The views in the middle, which get the width the sides leave. Give the
text `.truncate().grow(1.0)` so that it is what gets cut.

6085.name: movable
6085.docs:
Whether panels change places (they do by default). Without it the tabs stay where the app
put them, and only the sizes, the docks and closing are left.

345.name: new
345.docs: The days between these two, in whichever order they come.

4196.name: RightEnd
4196.docs: To the right of the anchor, bottom edges aligned.

999.name: swept
999.docs: The angles of a slice `t` of the way into a sweep that starts at `start`.

13206.name: ZStack

24759.name: flip
24759.docs: Picks `key` if it is not chosen and there is room; takes it off if it is.

15168.name: autofocus
15168.docs: Takes the focus when it first appears.

15822.name: theme_invalid
15822.docs: What was pasted is not tokens of a theme.

8774.name: new
8774.docs: A field bound to the picture's file.

1726.name: description
1726.docs: What the chart shows, under the title.

13279.name: disabled
13279.docs:
Takes no input while disabled, which leaves the pointer to what is underneath: for a
band that only works in one mode or with a key held.

17203.name: on_activate
17203.docs: Called with a row on a double click, or on Enter or Space.

3107.name: column
3107.docs: The column of the first character, from 1; 0 marks the whole line.

10809.name: matches_filter
10809.docs:
Does `value` (shown as `display`) pass a filter-row expression?

Numbers accept `>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `=`, `<>` and ranges `a..b`; everything
else is a case-insensitive "contains". This is the short syntax of one cell; only
[`run_query`] knows the columns that a filter-row expression names.

15968.name: recurrence_until
15968.docs: Before the last day, in words.

23670.name: PageHeader

24978.name: word_start
24978.docs: The start of the word before `at` (Alt/Ctrl+Left).

7031.name: set_size
7031.docs: Sets the size of a dock. A size that is no number is ignored.

2599.name: selected
2599.docs: Marks the swatch as the current choice.

6450.name: toggle
6450.docs: How thick the strip that collapses a dock is, or zero without one.

17349.name: new
17349.docs: The year in `year`, which its buttons and the keyboard also change.

14152.name: CompareView

710.name: fill
710.docs: Background, as a theme role (`SurfaceElevated` by default) or a literal color.

7177.name: TextArea

25778.name: on_expand
25778.docs: Runs with the key when an item opens, to bring what is under a [`TreeNode::lazy`] one.

4634.name: MotionEntry
4634.docs: One [`BuildCx::motion`] call of the latest build.

19384.name: expanded_binding
19384.docs: Reads and writes whether the submenu is unfolded from the app.

10447.name: key_text
10447.docs:
The text that identifies a row by this value, in
[`DataGrid::key_column`](crate::DataGrid::key_column).

25197.name: row_height
25197.docs: Height of a row of cells in logical pixels. 160 by default.

18149.name: paint
18149.docs:
Eases this node's own fill, border, shadow, corner radius and text color
whenever a build changes them, like CSS `transition`. Colors travel
through OKLab. Gradients and `Paint::Custom` change at once.

7904.name: Spinner
7904.docs: An indeterminate activity indicator. With reduced motion it is static.

4707.name: measure_content
4707.docs:
Asks the runtime to report the size of the content of `node`, read back
with [`Self::measured_content`] on the next build.

1510.name: radius_axis
1510.docs: Writes numbers along the radius of a radar chart.

12409.name: WaitingRow
12409.docs: A row that has not arrived from the server yet.

5361.name: advance_test
5361.docs: Moves the test along to the time `now` and says where it stands.

929.name: DrawIn
929.docs:
How a chart's data draws in the first time it is painted. Its axes, its grid and
their labels are there from the first frame.

22727.name: pointer
22727.docs: Where a drag is: across the timeline in view, and down its content.

15679.name: candle_close
15679.docs: Where a candle of a [`Chart`](crate::Chart) closed.

6088.name: edge_toggles
6088.docs:
Whether the strips that collapse the docks show (they do by default). Without them, the
app does it with [`DockLayout::set_open`].

7396.name: placeholder
7396.docs: Muted text shown while empty; by default the pattern with `_` in its slots.

11247.name: after
11247.docs:
The row just before `offset`, when it is at hand. With it a query can continue
from there (`WHERE key > ?`) and not walk past `offset` rows, which is what
makes `OFFSET` slow on a big table.

4199.name: Fill
4199.docs: Covers the whole viewport (dialogs, sheets); the anchor is ignored.

18949.name: header
18949.docs:
A view above the content that does not scroll. Reduced to icons, it
keeps its layout and shows what fits, so start it with an icon.

1002.name: paint_labels
1002.docs:
The labels, or only those on the data (`Some(true)`) or the others (`Some(false)`),
at a share of their strength.

22800.name: EventTip
22800.docs: The bubble over a bar: its whole name, when it is and its second line.

15752.name: close_tabs_to_right
15752.docs: Closes the tabs to the right in a [`DocumentTabs`](crate::DocumentTabs).

8704.name: new
8704.docs: A field bound to the files that came in.

15825.name: theme_contrast
15825.docs: A contrast, and the token it is measured over.

8777.name: label
8777.docs: The name screen readers announce, and the picture's alternative text.

1729.name: trend
1729.docs: A line at the bottom that says what the chart means, with an icon.

6234.name: panel_items
6234.docs: The items of a panel's menu.

20984.name: to_text
20984.docs: The rule as text, the part of iCalendar's `RRULE` it covers.

14590.name: paint_clip_marks
14590.docs: A triangle in each top corner that has clipping. Its presence says it, whatever the color.

7542.name: label
7542.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

3110.name: hint
3110.docs: How to fix it, when there is a likely way.

10812.name: search
10812.docs: Text searched in every visible column.

3764.name: disabled
3764.docs: Turns off the main command and the menu.

18514.name: capture_depth
18514.docs: Nested exits met while painting the subtree of an outer exit.

19168.name: new
19168.docs: A trigger for the sidebar that uses `state`.

15971.name: grid_grouped_by
15971.docs: Before a column a grid is grouped by.

1875.name: audio
1875.docs:
A recording. The player is built each time the message is shown, so that the clip
or the transcript that arrives later is there.

5726.name: ProgressBar

24981.name: delete_selection
24981.docs:
Removes the selection, leaving the caret where it was. Returns false when
nothing was selected.

7034.name: side_of
7034.docs: The place a panel is in, if it is not closed.

21784.name: Block
21784.docs: What a text is made of, from top to bottom.

16044.name: Rating

12847.name: Cover
12847.docs: Fills the frame, cropping the overflowing part (CSS `object-fit: cover`).

16698.name: FilmstripCell
16698.docs: What a cell of a [`Filmstrip`] is told when it is drawn.

13501.name: label
13501.docs:
The name screen readers announce while armed, instead of the one in
[`Labels`](crate::Labels).

6453.name: bottom
6453.docs: The smallest and the largest the bottom dock gets.

17352.name: marks
17352.docs: Says which days have something. It is asked for each day on each build.

3256.name: to_hex
3256.docs: `#RRGGBB`, or `#RRGGBBAA` when it is not opaque.

25054.name: flattened
25054.docs: A color as it looks on the canvas, whatever it lets through.

713.name: selected
713.docs:
Marks it as the chosen one among others: a thicker accent border and a tint of
the accent, with screen readers told which. Works with or without
[`Self::on_click`], and shows even with [`Self::border`] off.

9723.name: group
9723.docs: Lists the command under this group heading.

7180.name: FIRST_GUESS_WIDTH
7180.docs: Width assumed until the first layout says how wide a [`TextArea`] is.

23238.name: group
23238.docs: Adds a group of `(keys, what they do)`.

18152.name: surface_exit
18152.docs:
The exit fades this node as one surface: its content goes first, over the still
solid panel, and then the panel. Opacity applies to each shape on its own, so
fading all at once would show the panel through its fields, in a gray like metal.
The panel must be the first thing the node paints.

4710.name: on_context_menu
4710.docs: Calls `handler` with the pointer position on a secondary (right) click.

1513.name: center_text
1513.docs: A big number and a caption in the middle of a doughnut or of rings.

5364.name: set_view_costs
5364.docs: Says what each type of view cost in the latest build; see `Ui::view_costs`.

9869.name: SearchPanel
9869.docs:
A search box over a list of options, as a [`Combobox`] and a searchable
[`Select`](crate::Select) open. `pick` also has to close it.

21422.name: category
21422.docs: Contextual pages belong to a colored category and appear on demand.

22076.name: anchor
22076.docs: Where a tooltip about an item points at.

22730.name: reveal
22730.docs: A stretch of the content that has to come into view.

15682.name: VirtualList

8634.name: DropZone

23384.name: play
23384.docs: Starts `clip`, over whatever is already playing.

20187.name: new
20187.docs: A select over `options`; `selected` holds the zero-based index of the choice.

2240.name: size
2240.docs:
Its size in logical pixels (400 by 520 by default). A smaller window gets
less height.

13139.name: Thirds
13139.docs: Two lines each way, at a third and two thirds.

7399.name: read_only
7399.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

4202.name: BottomRight
4202.docs: The bottom-right corner of the viewport (toasts).

26000.name: seen
26000.docs: How many nodes each widget produced so far, to tell them apart.

1005.name: paint_drawing_in
1005.docs: The data while it draws in, with its labels and notes, but not the labels of the axes.

15755.name: wizard_back
15755.docs: Goes to the previous step of a [`Wizard`](crate::Wizard).

8707.name: most_files
8707.docs: The most files kept at once. No limit by default.

15828.name: copied
15828.docs: A code block's copy button, right after copying.

20333.name: effect_at
20333.docs: The effect at `seconds` for an element at `frame`.

13285.name: stage
13285.docs:
The view it goes over, such as an [`Image`](crate::Image) or a
[`ZoomPanView`](crate::ZoomPanView), which gives it its size. Without one, put it in
a [`ZStack`](crate::ZStack) with a fixed [size](Self::size).

14593.name: round_step
14593.docs: The round number at or above `least`: 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten.

7545.name: read_only
7545.docs: Shows the time without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

20406.name: CountUp
20406.docs:
A number that counts up from zero to its value, once, when it first shows on
screen. Under reduced motion it shows the value at once.

17209.name: estimated_height
17209.docs: How tall a row probably is until it has been measured (40 by default).

3113.name: tone
3113.docs: [`Tone::Danger`] for errors, [`Tone::Warning`] for warnings; other tones read as notes.

25565.name: TimelineEdit
25565.docs: What someone did to a block, for the app to apply.

26219.name: handle_event
26219.docs: Feeds one input event; returns true when a redraw is needed.

15974.name: grid_collapse_all
15974.docs: Closes every group of a grid.

1878.name: alt
1878.docs: What a photo shows, for screen readers.

23676.name: action
23676.docs: Adds a view at the end of the header, usually a button.

5729.name: new
5729.docs: A progress bar at `value`, clamped to 0.0–1.0.

24984.name: secure
24984.docs: Passwords can be pasted into but never copied out of.

7037.name: is_active
7037.docs: Whether this panel is the one its group shows.

26292.name: scroll_focus_into_view
26292.docs:
If focus just moved, scrolls each container around the focused element,
innermost first, just far enough to show it with its focus ring. Returns
true if something scrolled, which makes the frames stale.

16047.name: rating_value
16047.docs:
Where a [`Rating`](crate::Rating) stands, where `{0}` is its score and `{1}` its maximum.
[`Labels::rating_value`] fills it in.

12850.name: ContentMode
12850.docs: How an image fills its frame when their aspect ratios differ.

9653.name: bottom_inset
9653.docs:
Lifts the toasts by this much, in logical pixels, to clear something fixed
along the bottom of the window, such as a [`StatusBar`](crate::StatusBar).

17355.name: columns
17355.docs: How many months go on a line. As many as fit by default.

18009.name: on_test
18009.docs: Called with a model's position when someone asks to try it.

7183.name: wrap_lines
7183.docs:
Breaks `text` into lines that fit `width`, as ranges of char indices. Line
breaks in the text always break, the break itself belongs to no line, and
long lines break after a space, or anywhere in a word wider than `width`.

4640.name: foreground
4640.docs: The text color of the view being built, for content that takes it from what it is in.

23895.name: Footer
23895.docs:
The band that ends a page or an app: copyright, links, version, status.

It has a left, a center and a right area, each a tuple of views (up to 12)
or a `Vec`, whose items move to a new line when they do not fit. The center
stays centered however wide the sides are. Below 640 logical pixels of
window width (see [`Self::breakpoint`]) the areas stack, centered. Screen
readers find it as the page's `contentinfo` landmark.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Badge, Footer, Tone};

let footer = Footer::new()
    .left((Footer::text("© 2026 Raven Finance"),))
    .center((Footer::link("Privacy"), Footer::link("Terms")))
    .right((Footer::text("v27.1"), Badge::new("Online").tone(Tone::Success)));
```

13650.name: confined
13650.docs:
Like [`Self::apply`], as far as it goes while inside `bounds`. Without a ratio each axis
stops on its own, so a handle slides along an edge it reached.

6602.name: center
6602.docs: What the center gets, whatever is in it.

21352.name: toggle
21352.docs: A button that stays pressed while `value` is true (Bold, Ruler…).

18155.name: enter
18155.docs: When the node first appears, it starts from this effect.

208.name: View
208.docs:
Anything that can appear in the UI.

`build` runs whenever the UI rebuilds. It must be cheap and side-effect free:
read state, create layout boxes and paint instructions through `cx`, and
return the node that represents this view.

18809.name: SidebarInset
18809.docs:
The page beside a [`SidebarVariant::Inset`] sidebar: a raised surface that
takes the remaining room.

4713.name: request_focus
4713.docs:
Moves keyboard focus to this widget's focusable element after the build,
scrolling the containers around it until it shows.

1516.name: no_hover_motion
1516.docs:
The cursor, its dots and the focus go straight from one category to the next,
with no glide and no fade, as they do when the system asks for less motion.

5367.name: set_bug_reporter
5367.docs:
Adds a button to the panel that starts a bug report on the `new_issue` page.
`open` shows a URL to the person, in a browser on the desktop, and says why
when it cannot. Nothing is sent: the person reviews and submits on that page.

23387.name: speak_clip
23387.docs:
Says a recording, in place of anything still being said, so that
[`SoundProvider::stop_speaking`] stops it. By default it only plays.

20190.name: size
20190.docs:
Sets the height and text size to line up with a [`Button`] of the same size
(`Medium` by default).

2243.name: minimized
2243.docs: Adds a button that reduces it to its header and brings it back, kept in `minimized`.

17647.name: fail
17647.docs: Answers that the options could not be loaded, in words for the user.

21498.name: BODY_HEIGHT
21498.docs: Large button height area (icon + two lines of label).

4205.name: TopLeft
4205.docs: The top-left corner of the viewport; the anchor is ignored.

26003.name: active
26003.docs: The highlighted option of a combobox-style list.

8710.name: disabled
8710.docs: Turns the field off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

2316.name: ORB_DRAG_FROM
2316.docs: How far the pointer has to go for a press to become a drag, in logical pixels.

17066.name: By
17066.docs: Moves by this many logical pixels.

15177.name: range
15177.docs:
The least and the most scale, where 1 is 100%. By default, it goes down to what shows
the whole content and up to 1600%. What shows the whole content is always in range.

15831.name: release_newer
15831.docs: Goes to the next newer version in a [`ReleaseNotes`](crate::ReleaseNotes).

19682.name: panel_paint
19682.docs: The floating panel surface shared by menus, selects and popovers.

11399.name: fail
11399.docs: Says what went wrong. The grid offers to try again.

20409.name: new
20409.docs: Counts up to `value`, shown as a whole number with thousands separators.

17212.name: follow_end
17212.docs:
Starts at the end and stays there as rows arrive, as a chat does, until the user
scrolls away; coming back to the end takes it up again.

3116.name: Playground

7621.name: done
7621.docs: It already happened, so it stands back.

18520.name: NodePaint
18520.docs: The animatable part of what a node paints.

26222.name: access_tree
26222.docs:
The accessibility tree of the latest frame: roles, names, states and
frames of everything on screen, for screen readers. Call it after
[`Ui::update`]; platform layers send it to the operating system when it
changes. While a modal layer is open, only that layer is exposed.

15977.name: grid_clear_sort
15977.docs: Stops sorting by a grid's column.

1881.name: icon
1881.docs: The icon of a document ([`IconName::FileText`] by default).

5732.name: height
5732.docs: Sets the thickness of the bar in logical pixels (6 by default).

20482.name: run
20482.docs: The view `source` makes, or where and why it cannot make one.

7040.name: activate
7040.docs:
Brings a panel to the front of its group, and shows its dock if that was collapsed. It
says whether the panel is there at all; for one that was closed, see [`Self::reopen`].

14742.name: CURVE_MARGIN
14742.docs: Room around the plot of a [`CurveEditor`], in logical pixels, for the handles at its ends.

16050.name: ShortcutSheet

13507.name: grow
13507.docs:
How much of the free space along the parent stack it takes: 1 by default, or 0 over a
[stage](Self::stage), which then decides the size.

25060.name: theme
25060.docs: Offers a theme of the application's own to start from.

2681.name: columns
2681.docs: Sets how many swatches go in a row (8 by default).

3335.name: ShadeSquare
3335.docs: Focus and drags go by view, so each control of the panel is one.

14234.name: COMPARE_GAP
14234.docs: The space between the two pictures side by side.

7186.name: line_of
7186.docs:
The line holding char index `caret`. A caret at a soft break belongs to the
next line, where typing would continue.

4643.name: with_foreground
4643.docs:
Builds what `build` builds with `color` as its [`Self::foreground`]. Layers opened
inside it start without one, since they are not painted over this view.

21355.name: icon_only
21355.docs: Shows only the icon, with the label as tooltip.

4716.name: scrollable_virtual
4716.docs:
A scroll container in both directions whose content is rebuilt on every
scroll (see [`Self::scroll_viewport`]).
