27247.name: ravenrs_widgets
27247.docs:
Declarative views and the UI runtime.

# Writing components

There are three ways to make your own component, from simplest to most powerful:

1. **A function** returning `impl View`, composing existing views. Good for
   stateless pieces of UI.
2. **A [`Component`]**: a struct holding its state ([`State`](ravenrs_reactive::State)
   fields, bindings, callbacks) with a `body()` that composes views. This is the
   SwiftUI-style building block and covers most needs.
3. **A [`View`]** implemented directly: full control over layout boxes,
   painting (including arbitrary [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene) drawing through
   [`Paint::Custom`]), hit-testing, focus and click handling via [`BuildCx`].
   The built-in widgets are written this way, with no private API.

[`Canvas`] is the shortcut for custom drawing inside a normal layout.

# Features

* `decode` (default): PNG and JPEG decoding for [`Image::from_bytes`].
* `charts` (default): `Chart`, `BarChart`, `AreaChart` and `Barcode`. They draw
  the same charts and codes as reports, through `ravenrs-graphics`.

# Runtime

[`Ui`] owns the root view and turns it into a [`Scene`](ravenrs_core::Scene):
*build* (views to elements, tracked by a reactive observer), *layout* (Taffy),
*paint*. It only rebuilds when state the last build read has changed or the
interaction state (hover, press, focus) changed, and it never touches the GPU.

# Motion

A view declares how a node moves with [`BuildCx::motion`] and the runtime
plays it. While only animations run, frames repeat the paint phase alone, so
views are not rebuilt. When nothing moves, no frames are requested.

5984.name: DockArea

23350.name: seconds
23350.docs: How long it lasts, in seconds.

20153.name: MenuLevel
20153.docs: One panel of a menu, the first one or a submenu. `close` closes the whole menu.

15721.name: day_marked
15721.docs: What a [`YearView`](crate::YearView) says of a marked day without words of its own.

23423.name: sound

2279.name: panel_inside

17029.name: SAME_OFFSET

20880.name: ALL

11289.name: new
11289.docs: These rows, with more after them or not.

26039.name: LIVE_FRAME
26039.docs: Time between paints of animated drawing, in seconds.

11943.name: indent
11943.docs: How far the first column of a data row goes in, under its groups.

4895.name: action
4895.docs: Adds an action. Those that do not fit go to a menu, as in any [`Toolbar`].

15794.name: tag_add
15794.docs:
What an option of a [`TagBox`](crate::TagBox) says when it adds what was typed, where `{0}`
is what was typed. [`Labels::tag_add`] fills it in.

5549.name: Badge
5549.docs: A small pill label: status, counts, categories.

16448.name: id
16448.docs: What the selection keeps. The name by default.

6203.name: send
6203.docs: Sends a panel somewhere, keeping focus on its tab and saying where it went.

17102.name: total
17102.docs: How long all the rows are.

17756.name: remote
17756.docs: A lookup that asks `load` for its options when it opens and on every search.

10708.name: number
10708.docs: A right-aligned number column with thousands separators.

15867.name: diagnostics_report_failed
15867.docs: Diagnostics: the browser could not be opened for a bug report.

17829.name: new
17829.docs: Plays `animation` at its own size, over and over.

7584.name: label
7584.docs: The name screen readers announce. Both of its fields use it.

18483.name: Sampled
18483.docs: The values to paint a node with this frame.

15940.name: zoom_fit
15940.docs: Shows the whole content, in a [`ZoomControl`](crate::ZoomControl).

24296.name: inset
24296.docs:
Moves it toward the middle of the content, in logical pixels, as for a round
content whose corners are empty.

26258.name: set_reduced_motion
26258.docs:
Tells the runtime that the system asks for reduced motion. Things stop
traveling and springing; colors and opacity may still fade. A theme can
ask for the same through its `reduced_motion` token.

23061.name: keyframes
23061.docs:
Interpolates between effects at given points of the window, like CSS keyframes.
Before the first stop the first effect holds, after the last the last one does.
No stops is no effect.

16013.name: grid_edit_summary
16013.docs: Opens the editor of a column's summary.

21826.name: closes
21826.docs:
Where the mark opened at `at` closes: against the text, before the end, a space or
punctuation. A code mark closes at the next backtick, whatever is around it.

11581.name: on_export_file
11581.docs:
Shows an Export menu with Excel, PDF and CSV; `handler` receives the format and the rows
that match, as shown. `ravenrs-grid-export` turns these into a file.

4533.name: contents
4533.docs: Content size of each measured element in the last layout.

9038.name: Node
9038.docs:
One line or group of the builder. What it cannot show as a line stays as `Raw`,
so opening someone's expression never loses any of it. `values` is what a list
comparison holds; the others use `value`.

13543.name: new
13543.docs: An upright box that turns around its middle.

14851.name: settled
14851.docs:
This view within its limits: the scale in range and no empty space on an axis where
the content is larger than the view, so it cannot run away.

11654.name: HOVERED_ROW
11654.docs: The same under the pointer, always more than a shaded row.

22553.name: ranges
22553.docs: Shaded stretches of time across all rows.

828.name: KeptPicture
828.docs: A picture that is not on screen anymore.

4679.name: text_truncated
4679.docs:
Like [`Self::text`], on one line that ends with `…` when it does not fit.
Screen readers still get the whole text.

26477.name: StepRow
26477.docs: One line of the row of steps: its mark, its title, and what it says under the title.

1482.name: negative_color
1482.docs: The color of bars below zero.

7295.name: step
7295.docs: How much Up, Down and the buttons change the value. 1 by default.

13108.name: known_size
13108.docs: The size of the box as far as a build can know it, which the first build may not.

16959.name: on_reorder
16959.docs: Called with where a row was and where it should go.

20810.name: editing
20810.docs: Whether it is being edited, for starting from elsewhere, such as a menu.

21464.name: app_menu
21464.docs: The accent "File" button and its menu.

14416.name: HistogramScale
14416.docs: How a [`Histogram`] turns counts into heights.

25969.name: access
25969.docs:
Builds the accessibility tree from the element tree and performs the
actions assistive technology requests.

8022.name: SplitPanes

18921.name: wire_row_keys
18921.docs:
Up, Down, Home and End move between a sidebar's rows; Right and Left open
and close a row that has content below it.

15724.name: sortable_hint
15724.docs: How to move a row of a [`SortableList`](crate::SortableList) from the keyboard.

11946.name: lines
11946.docs: Where column lines go, from the left of the row.

15797.name: culture
15797.docs: The language and region of numbers and dates in files, such as `pt-BR`.

5552.name: new
5552.docs: A neutral badge with this text.

16451.name: size
16451.docs: How many bytes it has, if that is known.

17759.name: width
17759.docs: Width in logical pixels. 240 by default.

10711.name: format
10711.docs: Custom text for each value (also used by filtering, search and export).

466.name: EventCalendar

8168.name: Splitter

15870.name: diagnostics_report_truncated
15870.docs: After a report cut short to fit in a URL.

17832.name: speed
17832.docs: How fast it plays, 1.0 being as authored.

7587.name: read_only
7587.docs: Shows the value without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

16597.name: selection
16597.docs: The ids of the selected entries, to read and to change from outside.

20448.name: offset
20448.docs: Lands this far below the top, below a bar pinned over the page.

14708.name: new
14708.docs: A wheel bound to `value`, 160 logical pixels wide.

22410.name: resizable
22410.docs: Whether its length can change (on by default). It can still be moved.

26261.name: cursor
26261.docs: The cursor the platform should show.

12165.name: SUMMARY_KINDS
12165.docs: The kinds of summary to choose from, in the order the editor lists them.

23064.name: parallax
23064.docs:
Moves `distance` pixels down over the window: a negative distance moves it up.
Slower than the scroll, it reads as depth.

16016.name: grid_summary_formula
16016.docs: A column's summary from a formula.

5771.name: Skeleton
5771.docs: A placeholder block shown while content loads.

21829.name: read_aloud
21829.docs: The text a reader takes in, marks gone and one line per line.

14781.name: curve_move
14781.docs: Moves a point, staying between its neighbors so the curve remains a function.

18632.name: scrim
18632.docs:
The dimmed backdrop of a modal layer, which fades. It goes behind the panel as its
sibling: a fade on the panel's parent would reach the panel too.

11584.name: group_panel
11584.docs:
Shows or hides the space where columns are dropped to group by them. It shows
along with the toolbar, unless this says otherwise.

23137.name: top
23137.docs: Distance from the top of the scroll container while pinned.

5190.name: date
5190.docs:
A small civil-date type for calendars and date pickers (proleptic Gregorian,
no time zones), so date components need no external dependency.

16089.name: labels
16089.docs: The words the built-in components show or read aloud, in one place.

19940.name: icon
19940.docs: Shows an icon before the label.

11657.name: DETAIL_ARROW_WIDTH
11657.docs: Room for the arrow that opens a row's details, and for a row's check box.

22556.name: resource_width
22556.docs: The width of the resources column (200 by default).

9114.name: Editor
9114.docs: What the rows of the builder need to edit the tree.

23864.name: Grid
23864.docs: Lays children out in equal-width columns, wrapping into rows.

2720.name: Bottom
2720.docs: The middle of the bottom edge.

11076.name: group_ranges
11076.docs: Where each group of `result` starts in its `matched` rows, and how many it has.

4682.name: on_click
4682.docs: Calls `handler` when the node is clicked, or activated with Enter/Space while focused.

1485.name: dot_icon
1485.docs: Draws this icon on each point of a line, in place of a dot.

12384.name: DragGhost
12384.docs: What follows the pointer during a drag.

9187.name: HoverCard
9187.docs:
Rich content shown below a trigger while the pointer is over the trigger or
the card itself.

20086.name: SUBMENU_GRACE
20086.docs: How long the pointer can cross other rows on its way to an open submenu.

5990.name: closable
5990.docs: Whether it has a way to close. The app can still close it through the arrangement.

6644.name: arrange
6644.docs: Lays an arrangement out in an area of `size`.

21394.name: dialog_launcher
21394.docs: The small arrow in the group caption that opens the full dialog.

7298.name: prefix
7298.docs: Text before the number without focus, such as a currency.

16962.name: new
16962.docs: A list of `count` rows, in the order the app keeps.

20813.name: size
20813.docs: The height and text size, in both forms so that nothing moves (`Small` by default).

21467.name: selected_page
21467.docs: Where the selected page index lives (otherwise the ribbon keeps it).

18270.name: motion
18270.docs:
Implicit animation: a view declares how a node moves, and the runtime plays
it during paint.

Tracks live here, outside the view tree, keyed by identity. A build only sets
targets. Frames in between run the paint phase alone, so an animation does
not rebuild views or lay them out again.

25972.name: AccessMap
25972.docs: Maps accessibility ids back to elements for [`Ui::perform_action`].

11876.name: formula_cache
11876.docs: What formulas came to, by column and range of rows, until the rows change.

9333.name: SplashScreen

17035.name: Known
17035.docs: Given by whoever uses the list.

4247.name: Shortcut

11949.name: formula_text
11949.docs: What a formula comes to over a stretch of the matching rows.

5555.name: color
5555.docs:
Uses this color instead of the tone's, for categories that have their own.
The text moves toward the ink, so that it stays readable on the tint.

16454.name: icon
16454.docs: An icon of its own, instead of the one for a folder or a file.

17762.name: read_only
17762.docs: Shows the choice without letting it change; it can still be focused and read.

15219.name: content_size
15219.docs: The size of the content the view shows, when `image` is a smaller version of it.

8171.name: ratio
8171.docs: The first pane's initial share, within the limits (0.1 to 0.9 by default).

24883.name: placeholder
24883.docs: Muted text shown while the value is empty.

11441.name: chunk_size
11441.docs: How many rows to ask for at a time.

15292.name: label
15292.docs: Text after the switch; clicking it toggles too.

16600.name: height
16600.docs: A fixed height. It takes the height its parent gives it by default.

14057.name: on_step
14057.docs: On the step and in the range, and never a negative zero.

10860.name: level
10860.docs: Nesting depth, 0 for the outermost groups.

14711.name: label
14711.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

4466.name: focus_visible
4466.docs: Focus came from the keyboard, so the ring is shown.

26264.name: tell_appeared
26264.docs: Runs the `on_appear` handlers of elements that show for the first time.

8317.name: new
8317.docs: A field with this label above `content`.

23067.name: easing
23067.docs: Shapes the progress inside the window (linear by default).

16019.name: grid_formula_error
16019.docs: Where a formula could not be worked out.

5774.name: line
5774.docs: A block that stretches across its stack.

18635.name: Segmented
18635.docs: A rounded track with the open tab raised in it, for a few short choices.

11587.name: scenarios
11587.docs:
Offers saving its arrangement under a name and coming back to it. Keep the list
with [`GridScenario::list_to_json`].

8390.name: FileUpload

16092.name: dock_options_name
16092.docs: The name of the button with the menu of the panel `title`.

19943.name: on_select
19943.docs: Runs `handler` when the item is chosen; the menu closes first.

1996.name: Chat

13549.name: to_local
13549.docs: The point of the upright box that ends up at `world` once turned.

107.name: Mini
107.docs: 22 px tall, caption text; a [`StatusBar`](crate::StatusBar)'s actions.

22559.name: avatars
22559.docs: Shows the initials of each row's name beside it, for rows that are people.

5266.name: REFRESH
5266.docs:
How often the open panel shows new numbers, in seconds. Its own rebuilds are
frames too, so this stays slow enough not to weigh on what it measures.

2723.name: AnchorPoint
2723.docs: One of the nine points of a [`NinePointAnchor`].

7228.name: cursor
7228.docs: Caret and selection kept by whoever built the area, so it can insert at the caret.

180.name: Join
180.docs: Where a button stands in a [`ButtonGroup`].

11079.name: to_tsv
11079.docs:
Rows as tab-separated text, the way spreadsheets copy and paste: the
shown (formatted) values of the `visible` columns, no header.

4031.name: Live
4031.docs: Arbitrary drawing that keeps changing (spinners, pulses), without rebuilding.

4685.name: control_in
4685.docs:
The first described or focusable node at or under `node`, in tree
order: the control a label or tooltip around it is about.

1488.name: tick_format
1488.docs: How categories are written on the axis, such as a month's first letters.

7301.name: width
7301.docs: Fixed width in logical pixels; by default the field stretches.

4104.name: phase
4104.docs: Which part of the drag this event is.

7955.name: height
7955.docs: Slide area height in logical pixels (default 240).

4758.name: file_name_and_size
4758.docs: The name of a file with its size: what a row of a file says first.

15657.name: close
15657.docs: Closes a dialog or a sheet.

20816.name: placeholder
20816.docs: Muted text shown while the name is empty.

15076.name: GLIDE_RESPONSE
15076.docs: The response of the spring behind a throw: the longer, the farther it coasts.

8028.name: inverted
8028.docs: The size grows as the bar moves left or up, for a pane after the bar.

15730.name: dock_empty
15730.docs: What a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea) says with nothing in its center.

9336.name: SPLASH_REST_LAG
9336.docs: How long after the name the rest of a [`SplashScreen`] appears, in seconds.

2288.name: FreeLayer
2288.docs: A panel placed anywhere, dragged by its header.

6793.name: edge
6793.docs: The side the new group opens on.

3596.name: FloatingToolbar

399.name: today
399.docs: Marks this day with a ring.

10717.name: resizable
10717.docs:
Whether people can change the width, by the handle or the column's menu (they can
by default). With `false`, it keeps the width it has been given, or what a
[`Self::fill`] column gets from the room left.

15222.name: label
15222.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

22924.name: draw_handler
22924.docs: What drawing on an empty stretch does, if the scheduler can create.

15876.name: month_year
15876.docs: Between a month and its year, such as `" "` or `" de "`.

24886.name: width
24886.docs: Fixed width in logical pixels; by default the field stretches.

11444.name: peak_rows
11444.docs: The most rows it has held at any moment.

14060.name: CropOverlay

10863.name: count
10863.docs: Number of data rows in the group.

15368.name: RadioGroup
15368.docs:
One choice among several, shown as radio buttons. Arrow keys move the
selection and the focus together (wrapping); Home and End jump to the ends.

8320.name: required
8320.docs: Marks the label with `*` and adds the [`validate::required`] rule (for the value set by [`FormField::validate`]).

37.name: into
37.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

21835.name: Text
21835.docs: Text in the theme's type scale. It wraps to the width its container offers.

11590.name: selected_keys
11590.docs:
Where the keys of the selected rows live, with
[`key_column`](Self::key_column). Unlike row indices, keys still mean the same
records after the data is replaced.

8393.name: ImageField

16095.name: dock_resize_name
16095.docs: The name of the bar that resizes a dock.

19946.name: item
19946.docs:
Adds an item to this item's submenu, which opens at its side on hover, on click or
with the Right arrow; Left and Escape come back. An item with a submenu does not
run [`Self::on_select`].

23797.name: vertical
23797.docs: Scrolls up and down, taking the height its parent gives it.

13552.name: BoxHandle
13552.docs: One of the eight handles of a [`TransformHandles`].

25105.name: TileSpot
25105.docs:
Where a tile stands: which tile, and how many cells it takes. The order of a list
of these is the order on the screen.

18057.name: corner_radius
18057.docs: Rounds the box corners; radius in logical pixels.

7812.name: ExpressionEditor

22562.name: lane_menu
22562.docs: What a right click on an empty stretch offers, given the row and the time there.

15514.name: Stepper
15514.docs:
Decrement / value / increment, for small integer quantities. When focused,
arrow keys step by one and Home / End jump to the limits.

5269.name: PANEL_WIDTH
5269.docs: The panel's width in logical pixels.

16168.name: two_numbers
16168.docs: A template with `{0}` and `{1}` filled in with these, each written where it goes.

16822.name: paged
16822.docs: The pages of a document in a column.

2726.name: ALL
2726.docs: All nine, row by row from the top left.

7231.name: rows
7231.docs: How many lines are visible; more than that scroll. 4 by default.

183.name: new
183.docs: A primary, medium button with this label. An empty label makes it icon-only.

21981.name: Picture
21981.docs: What the diagram looked like when it was last laid out, relative to its frame.

4688.name: focusable
4688.docs: Makes the node reachable with Tab; the focus ring uses `corner_radius`.

1491.name: grid_columns
1491.docs:
Upright gridlines evenly spread into this many columns, instead of one at each
category or number.

7304.name: disabled
7304.docs: Turns the field off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

4107.name: container
4107.docs: The frame of the dragged element's parent (e.g. a splitter's container).

22127.name: at
22127.docs: This hour and minute of this day.

15733.name: dock_bottom
15733.docs: The bottom dock of a [`DockArea`](crate::DockArea), in a menu.

1637.name: BarChart
1637.docs:
A bar chart with labels under each bar and faint gridlines.

Available with the `charts` feature, on by default.

6796.name: Side
6796.docs: Into a place as a whole: its first group, or a new one if it holds nothing.

402.name: span
402.docs: Shades these days, with both ends as if selected.

22854.name: tinted
22854.docs: A tint over this surface with a stripe of its color, instead of a solid bar.

16460.name: id
16460.docs: What identifies it in the selection, when names can repeat.

9412.name: SplashBar
9412.docs: A progress bar named for screen readers.

24162.name: RAIL_HOLD
24162.docs: How long a press on a tool with variants takes to open them, in seconds.

10720.name: summary
10720.docs: Shows this aggregate in group rows and the footer.

15879.name: form_errors
15879.docs: Above the errors that keep a form from being saved.

23581.name: ZLayer
23581.docs:
One layer of a [`ZStack`]: a box of no height, so that the layers overlap, around
a box that reports the height the content really takes.

24889.name: prefix
24889.docs: Any view inside the field, before the text, such as a currency or a unit.

11447.name: len
11447.docs:
How many rows the grid shows: all of them when the total is known, or what has
come so far and a little more, so that the scrollbar has somewhere to go.

4399.name: measured_content
4399.docs: The size of the content of this view's measured node in the last layout.

26197.name: views
26197.docs:
The visible area of the scroll container around each element (the window for
those outside any), for pinned elements and scroll-linked effects.

5053.name: avatar
5053.docs: A leading avatar showing the initials of `name`.

13409.name: pick
13409.docs:
Tells it the color of the point clicked. It counts only while armed, and returns whether
it did.

21111.name: Link
21111.docs: A label to click and what clicking it does, such as opening a page.

17914.name: error
17914.docs: What went wrong the last time, in words.

15371.name: new
15371.docs: Radio buttons for `options`; `selected` holds the zero-based index.

26270.name: modal_root
26270.docs:
The topmost full-window layer (dialog, sheet, command palette): while it
is open, focus stays inside it.

8323.name: tint
8323.docs: A faint color behind the field, to call attention to it.

694.name: Fill
694.docs:
A color given either as a theme role (preferred, follows theme changes) or
as a literal color.

11593.name: on_add_row
11593.docs: Shows an Add button in the toolbar. The handler adds the row, or opens a form to.

8396.name: size
8396.docs: Its size on disk. A file bigger than the request allowed comes with no bytes.

5199.name: weekday
5199.docs: Day of the week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday.

16098.name: dock_closed_name
16098.docs: What is announced after the panel `title` closed.

2002.name: assistant_writing
2002.docs:
What the assistant is still answering. Whoever answers writes to `text`, from
any thread, and asks for a rebuild with a [`UiWaker`](crate::UiWaker). While it
is empty, the message shows that it is on its way.

16752.name: selection
16752.docs:
The selected cells, to read and to change from outside. A single one that changes from
outside is brought into view.

13555.name: shrunk_inside
13555.docs:
Made smaller around its middle until it is inside `bounds`, for a box that turns around
its middle. A crop does this as it is turned, the way a frame must over a still picture.

25108.name: new
25108.docs: A tile taking this many cells.

18060.name: frame
18060.docs: Fixes the width and/or height in logical pixels; `None` keeps the content size.

25762.name: tree
25762.docs: Items inside items: a tree that opens, selects, checks and filters.

7815.name: new
7815.docs: An editor of `value`, offering the built-in functions, operators and constants.

22565.name: on_change
22565.docs: An event was moved or resized.

26416.name: wire
26416.docs:
Takes focus if an arrow key moved it here, and handles arrow keys on
`node`. `on_move` runs with the new index (to select it, for patterns
where selection follows focus).

5272.name: FRAME_BUDGET
5272.docs: The line across the picture: a frame at 120 Hz.

16171.name: LinkOpener
16171.docs:
Opens an address outside the app. Platform layers install one with
[`crate::Ui::set_links`]: the browser navigates, the desktop asks the system's browser.

10431.name: apply
10431.docs:
Arranges a grid as `layout` says. A column it does not name stays where it is, at
the end, and a name it has that the grid does not is ignored.

186.name: on_click
186.docs: Runs `handler` when the button is clicked or activated with Enter or Space.

14936.name: new
14936.docs: A control bound to `view`, with small buttons.

4691.name: on_drag
4691.docs: Receives pointer drags that start on the node (sliders, splitters...).

19441.name: row_paint
19441.docs: A row's fill, shared by its button and the box around its actions.

1494.name: value_domain
1494.docs:
The value axis goes exactly from `min` to `max`, and what is past them is cut
off. Its numbers are the round ones in between. Not for expanded stacks.

16898.name: reorder
16898.docs:
The arithmetic and the drag of a reorder, shared by whatever lets its pieces be moved: rows,
tabs, and later docked panels.

17552.name: RunOutput
17552.docs: What a [`Runner`] heard from the code since it was last asked.

18860.name: is_open
18860.docs:
Whether the sidebar is showing: its sheet in a narrow window, otherwise
the column at full width.

4764.name: SendOptions
4764.docs: How a file can be sent, for an [`Attachment`].

26562.name: build_each
26562.docs: Builds each child in order and appends its node to `out`.

12466.name: DetailRow
12466.docs: What a row shows below itself when open. It stays in sight while the columns scroll.

9269.name: new

2005.name: RichText

Text with a little formatting, written the way chat apps write it: `*bold*`, `_italic_`,
`~struck~`, `` `code` ``, a fenced block of ```` ``` ````, lines that start with `* `, `- `
or `> `, and web addresses, which become links.

It wraps to the width it is offered, between words, and a marked piece stays with the
punctuation around it. Text with nothing to format is drawn as one [`Text`], for the same
cost. Links take the keyboard: Tab reaches them, and Enter or Space opens them. It only
recognizes `http` and `https`, and it hands the address to [`Self::on_link`] instead of
opening anything.

`ravenrs-text` shapes one style per text and embeds neither an italic nor a monospace
font, so italics are told apart by a muted color and code by a chip behind it.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{RichText, Ui};

let text = RichText::new("*Ready:* see `report.pdf` at https://example.com/r")
    .on_link(|address| println!("open {address}"));
let mut ui = Ui::new(text, ravenrs_style::Theme::raven_dark());
ui.update();
```

Opens the panel and redraws the window nonstop for a few seconds, to tell

24253.name: size

A pending focus move inside a group: which item takes focus on its next

when nothing else changed (arrow keys in a toolbar only move focus).

25561.name: TrimmedStart

26215.name: frame_start

15970.name: grid_drag_hint

1874.name: document

24980.name: word_at

7033.name: contains
7033.docs: Whether a panel is in the tree, whether or not it is what shows.

16043.name: grid_selected

13500.name: new
13500.docs: An area of this eyedropper that reads colors with `sampler`.

6452.name: right

17351.name: today

Makes the whole card a button: it runs `handler` when clicked, or on

4563.name: LocalStore

Widget-local state that survives rebuilds, keyed by widget identity and

9722.name: new

7179.name: editors

Editors for values a plain text field cannot hold well: long text, numbers,

11030.name: contains_lowercase

Case-insensitive "contains" where `needle` is already lowercase. ASCII text,

25780.name: disabled

23237.name: title

21348.name: RibbonItem
21348.docs: A command in a ribbon group: a button, a toggle, or a button with a menu.

18151.name: shared_layout

Makes this node the same visual object as the node of a previous build
with the same `scope` and `tag`, wherever it is now: a selection marker
that slides from the old tab to the new one. `scope` is usually the
widget id of the common parent.

4709.name: shortcut_with_shift

Like [`Self::shortcut`], for a key that also needs Shift. Register it before the
same key without Shift, which would otherwise answer first.

1512.name: tracks
1512.docs: Draws a track behind each ring of a radial chart.

Picks one option from a list, shown in a field-like trigger. Enter, Space or
an arrow key opens the list with the current option focused; arrows move,
Enter picks, Escape closes, and focus returns to the field.

22075.name: panel
22075.docs: What a tooltip says about an item.

22729.name: view_width
22729.docs: How wide the timeline in view is, as of the last build.

15681.name: sankey_cycle
15681.docs:
What a [`SankeyChart`](crate::SankeyChart) says when its flows go in a circle,
before the names of the nodes.

8633.name: push_refusals
8633.docs: One line for each refused file, saying why.

23383.name: snap
23383.docs:
A burst of noise over a short tone, both dying out fast, the way plastic
sounds when struck.

2239.name: new
2239.docs: A closed panel called `title`, the name screen readers give its sphere.

13138.name: gesture_paint
13138.docs:
A painter that keeps asking for frames during a gesture, which then costs no build, and that
costs nothing afterwards.

6090.name: label
6090.docs: What screen readers call the area, instead of the name in [`Labels`].

17643.name: LookupResponder

Delivers the answer to a [`LookupRequest`], now or later on the UI thread. An

11249.name: RemoteRows

1004.name: paint_swept_slices

The slices of a round chart `t` of the way into their sweep, each ring from its

2312.name: ORB_BOX

17062.name: ToIndex

15173.name: image

8779.name: read_only

1731.name: centered
1731.docs: Centers the title and the bottom lines, as round charts do.

20332.name: float

13284.name: size

14592.name: RULER_TICKS_PER_PIXEL
14592.docs:
Largest number of tick marks a ruler draws per logical pixel of length: a guard for
nonsense scales, since the step already keeps real ones far below this.

25491.name: Timeline
25491.docs:
Things along time, on named tracks, under a ruler with markers and a playhead.

It holds nothing: the app gives it what is there and where the playhead is,
and gets back what people do. Blocks are buttons, so they work with the
keyboard. Dragging the ruler moves the playhead, dragging a
[movable](TimelineItem::movable) block moves it, and the ends of a
[trimmable](TimelineItem::trimmable) one change its length.

```
use ravenrs_widgets::{Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineTrack, Tone};

let timeline = Timeline::new(vec![
    TimelineTrack::new("Notes", 34.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(1, 2_000, 3_000, "Callout").movable()]),
    TimelineTrack::new("Film", 56.0, vec![TimelineItem::new(2, 0, 10_000, "Take 1").tone(Tone::Accent)]),
])
.position_ms(4_000)
.on_seek(|ms| println!("{ms}"));
```

7544.name: disabled
7544.docs: Turns the picker off: it fades, leaves the tab order and ignores input.

11395.name: GridResponder
11395.docs:
Answers one [`GridRequest`], now or later. An answer to a question nobody is asking
any more, because the filters changed meanwhile, is dropped.

9506.name: BottomCenter
9506.docs: The middle of the bottom edge.

17208.name: key
17208.docs:
What identifies a row, which is its position by default. With it, a row keeps its
measured height and what is on screen stays still when rows come in above. It is
asked for every row on each build, so it should only read a value.

10814.name: key
10814.docs: Unique path of this group, used to collapse it.

3766.name: item
3766.docs: Appends an alternative to the menu.

25564.name: TrimmedEnd
25564.docs: A block's end moved by this much.

18516.name: Ui
18516.docs:
The platform-independent UI runtime: owns the root view, reacts to input and
state changes, and produces a [`Scene`] for the renderer.

Platform layers drive it with [`Ui::set_viewport`], [`Ui::handle_event`] and
[`Ui::update`], and register a waker with [`Ui::set_waker`] to schedule a
frame when state changes outside of event handling (timers, async tasks).

26218.name: set_viewport
26218.docs: Sets the viewport in logical pixels and the device scale factor.

12122.name: DRAG_FROM
12122.docs: What the pointer has to travel before a press becomes a drag, and not a click.

15973.name: grid_expand_all
15973.docs: Opens every group of a grid.

1877.name: side
1877.docs: The side of a photo, which is shown square (240 logical pixels by default).

23675.name: badge
23675.docs: Adds a view beside the title, usually a badge.

20478.name: playground
20478.docs:
A place to write code and see what it makes: a [`CodeEditor`] beside the result,
examples to start from, and the problems the code has, marked where they are.

7036.name: closed_panels
7036.docs: The ids closed, in the order they closed.

26291.name: place_all
26291.docs: Gives every element its absolute frame, scroll offsets and overlays included.

16046.name: rating_value
16046.docs: Where a [`Rating`](crate::Rating) stands, from its score and its maximum.

12849.name: Fill
12849.docs: Stretches to the frame, ignoring the aspect ratio.

9652.name: position
9652.docs:
Where in the window the toasts stack (the bottom-right corner by default). A toast
can ask for another place with [`ToastExtras::position`].

6455.name: pane_min
6455.docs: The smallest a group gets along a split.

17354.name: on_month
17354.docs: Makes the name of each month a button, called with its first day.

25056.name: ThemeEditor
25056.docs:
Changes the tokens of the theme on screen, which follows at once: colors, the radii and the
sizes of text. It warns when text stops being legible on its ground, and copies what changed
as JSON, or takes it back, so an application can keep it wherever it wants.

18008.name: on_cancel
18008.docs: Called with a model's position when someone stops its download.

7763.name: RecurrenceRule

715.name: QuadPaint
715.docs: A rounded rectangle painted behind an element's children.

12922.name: decode_image
12922.docs: Decodes PNG or JPEG bytes into RGBA pixels.

9725.name: shortcut
9725.docs: Shows a shortcut hint, e.g. `"⌘S"` (display only).

7182.name: BORDER_ROOM
7182.docs: What the area's border takes at its edge, focused or not, kept clear of the gutter.

25783.name: collect_tips
25783.docs: The keys at the tips of the branch: what a check really holds.

4639.name: value_moving
4639.docs: A value from [`Self::animated`] is still moving.

1442.name: Look
1442.docs: What [`PlotStyle`] takes as it is. The theme and the data fill in the rest.

13649.name: apply
13649.docs:
`start` with its handle moved by this much along the box's own axes. The opposite handle,
or the pivot, stays where it was on screen.

6601.name: toggles
6601.docs: The strips that collapse the docks.

18154.name: underlay
18154.docs:
Paints the node's own shape behind all its siblings, so a moving marker
slides under the labels it crosses. The node must be a direct child of
the container holding those siblings.

7909.name: color
7909.docs:
Sets the color; by default it comes from the theme accent, which disappears
on an accent fill.

18808.name: Floating
18808.docs: A rounded, raised panel away from the window's edges.

4712.name: on_pointer_move
4712.docs:
Calls `handler` with the pointer position and the element's absolute frame
whenever the pointer moves over it, for something that depends on where inside
it the pointer is. [`is_hover_within`](Self::is_hover_within) says when it left.

1515.name: no_hover_focus
1515.docs:
Keeps the chart as it is around the category under the pointer: the other
bars and slices do not fade, and no slice comes forward. The tooltip and the
cursor stay.

5366.name: set_report_source
5366.docs:
Sets how to describe the GPU. Describing it can take a moment, so `source`
only runs when the panel first needs it, and again after the next call here.

15684.name: Filmstrip

20189.name: searchable
20189.docs: Opens with a search box that filters the options as you type.

2242.name: movable
2242.docs:
Lets it go anywhere in the window, dragged by its header or moved with the arrow
keys on it, without the sphere: `open` is what opens it. `place` holds its top-left
corner, so the app can remember it, and is written when a drag ends; `None` puts it
in the corner at the bottom right. It stays inside a window that gets smaller.

13141.name: Divisions
13141.docs: This many equal parts each way, such as a fine grid to level a horizon.

4204.name: BottomCenter
4204.docs: The middle of the bottom edge of the viewport; the anchor is ignored.

8709.name: label
8709.docs: The name screen readers announce. Inside a [`crate::FormField`], its label is used instead.

20262.name: Dialog

2315.name: ORB_EDGE
2315.docs: How far the sphere's box keeps from the edges of the window.

6166.name: DropAim
6166.docs: What a tab being dragged would do if dropped here.

15176.name: grow
15176.docs: How much of the free space along the parent stack it takes (1 by default).

15830.name: release_versions
15830.docs: The list of versions in a [`ReleaseNotes`](crate::ReleaseNotes).

17138.name: tops

3696.name: along

14595.name: ruler_number

25494.name: new

8274.name: on_complete

15976.name: grid_sort_descending

5731.name: color

20481.name: RESULT_SHARE

14741.name: CurveEditor

25059.name: new

18011.name: on_remove

2680.name: selected

6531.name: Split

1445.name: tooltip_asked
1445.docs: The small kinds only say anything if asked to.

21354.name: small

25859.name: height

18811.name: SidebarVariant

864.name: widths

Keyboard modifiers as of the latest input event, readable from click

9220.name: Side

20119.name: switch_submenu

20773.name: SliderPanel

6677.name: DockEdge

21427.name: new

22735.name: commit

23389.name: SoundProvider

Plays sounds and speaks. Platform layers install one with
[`crate::Ui::set_sound`]; until then, nothing is heard.

20192.name: width
20192.docs: Sets the width in logical pixels (220 by default).

13144.name: GoldenRatio
13144.docs: Two lines each way, at the golden ratio.

3553.name: entry_node
3553.docs: The element of one entry of a bar of commands.

25351.name: move_to_cell

4207.name: TopRight
4207.docs: The top-right corner of the viewport; the anchor is ignored.

1010.name: at
1010.docs: The category, between two of them while it glides from one to the other.

4861.name: AttachmentRow
4861.docs: One row of an [`AttachmentStrip`], with an identity of its own for its menu and button.

15760.name: StepIndicator

20265.name: new
20265.docs: A dialog shown while `open` is true.

15179.name: label
15179.docs: The name screen readers announce, instead of the one in [`Labels`](crate::Labels).

11982.name: Chip
11982.docs: A grouped column, from its chip.

15833.name: release_of
15833.docs: Between the position and the total, as in "2 of 5".

19684.name: panel
19684.docs:

17141.name: padding

3699.name: BarSurface

1156.name: indicator

15906.name: Ribbon

23608.name: PropertyRow

9512.name: travel

17214.name: on_visible

18522.name: sample
18522.docs: The node's values at this frame. `shift` is what scrolling added to its frame.

15979.name: grid_ungroup_column
15979.docs: Stops grouping a grid by a column, in its menu.

8931.name: values

Values to pick from for "is any of": the key as the expression writes it

5734.name: percent
5734.docs: Shows the percentage above the bar, at its end.

20484.name: watch

Calls `wake` whenever there is something new for [`Self::take_output`], so the

14744.name: CURVE_MIN_GAP
14744.docs: The least horizontal distance between two points, as a fraction of the plot.

18595.name: Collapse
18595.docs:
Animates its content's height as it opens and closes: the "height: auto"
transition. The content stays built until it has finished closing.

26297.name: scroll_effect
26297.docs: The effect element `i`'s scroll link gives at the current scroll position.

12201.name: FooterCell
12201.docs: A column's total at the bottom: click to change what it sums up.

16052.name: favorite
16052.docs: What a [`FavoriteToggle`](crate::FavoriteToggle) is called when nothing says what it marks.

23754.name: new
23754.docs: A scroll view of `children` (a tuple of up to 12 views or a `Vec`).

20557.name: Extra
20557.docs: A button the app adds to the bar, which gets the code as it is.

11620.name: Shared
11620.docs: Everything a row needs to build itself.

9077.name: node_at
9077.docs: Walks to the node at `path`, for an edit coming from a button or a field.

2683.name: on_pick
2683.docs: Runs `handler` with the color and the keys held, on a click or on Enter and Space.

7188.name: LineMark
7188.docs: A line a code area marks: its index from 0, the color, and the char columns to underline.

21938.name: sankey
21938.docs:
A sankey diagram: how much flows from what to what. The layout comes from
`ravenrs-graphics`; here its nodes become quads, its ribbons become shapes, so
they can fade one by one, and its labels become text.

794.name: MAX_BAR_WIDTH
794.docs: The widest a bar gets, so a few bars in a wide chart still read as bars.

4645.name: foreground

The text color of the view being built, if a view around it set one with
[`Self::with_foreground`]. Colors do not cascade by themselves, so this is how
a [`Kbd`](crate::Kbd) inside a filled button reads as part of the button.

20049.name: element
20049.docs: Shown instead of the label, which still names the row.

21357.name: menu_item
21357.docs: Adds a drop-down item; a button with items opens a menu.

22011.name: touches_flow
22011.docs: Whether this flow is what is in focus, or goes in or out of the node that is.

25862.name: new
25862.docs: A tree of these items, all closed.

867.name: Parts
867.docs:
The pictures of a chart's backdrop, of its data and of its notes, apart, for its
data to draw in over a backdrop that stays put.

4718.name: scrollable
4718.docs:
Makes the node a vertical scroll container: its children scroll with the
wheel or trackpad, are clipped, and a scrollbar shows while they move.
Give the node `LayoutStyle::overflow_hidden` so it does not grow to fit.

15617.name: ThemeSwitcher
15617.docs:
Switches the app between its dark, light and glass themes: Raven Dark, Raven Light and
Raven Glass, unless the app has its own.

1521.name: spoken_values
1521.docs: Every series' values, as a screen reader hears them.

6026.name: DockTabBar
6026.docs: When a group of a [`DockArea`] shows its tabs.

7334.name: fraction_digits
7334.docs: The fewest decimals that show `n` as it is, when editing it.

15690.name: previous_page
